item.title: Bond market is a buy right now, JP Morgan Asset Management's fixed income head says
item.description: There is a "generational amount of yield" in bond markets and it is time to buy debt, with a return of as much as 8% on offer in the US over the next the year, Bob Michele, J.P. Morgan Asset Management's head of global fixed income, said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: There is a "generational amount of yield" in bond markets and it is time to buy debt, with a return of as much as 8% on offer in the US over the next the year, Bob Michele, J.P. Morgan Asset Management's head of global fixed income, said on Tuesday. The bond market has rebounded following a selloff this month and last, especially in developed-market sovereign debt: "We expect both the Fed funds rate and the Treasury curve to converge (around 4.5%)," Michele told reporters in Singapore "Generally at the end of a hiking cycle the yield curve is flat ... so there's plenty of room for yields to run from where they are," he said Carry and price appreciation are likely to deliver a return in the US market of 7% to 8% over the next 12 months, he said US 10-year yields were around 4.99% on Tuesday having spent much of the past few weeks above 5% Investors expect the Fed funds rate window to stay at 3.75% to 4% when the Federal Reserve announces its interest rate decision on Wednesday "There is yield all over the place," said Michele. "When we looked at the Treasury curve a few weeks ago when it first went above 5%, to us the buy signal was real yield in the US that got to 3%. The last time we saw that was 2002. So at close to 25 years, that's a buying opportunity." Japan, Australia, investment-grade credit and emerging market sovereign debt are among the stronger picks, he said. "Everyone senses there's a generational amount of yield in bond markets," he said. "It's pretty clear with the global capex cycle out there, recession is a very low probability. That means every backup in credit spread (you) should buy." The "tail risk," he said, was the Fed needing to hike much further than 4.5% to contain inflation

item.title: Singapore foreign minister heads to Indonesia amid tensions over gas and haze
item.description: Indonesia will host Singapore's top diplomat on Tuesday, its foreign ministry said, as tensions simmer between the two neighbours over persistent haze from Indonesia's wildfires and Jakarta's decision to cut gas supplies to the city-state.
item.dc:creator: Xinghui Kok, Fransiska Nangoy
item.content:encoded: Indonesia will host Singapore's top diplomat on Tuesday, its foreign ministry said, as tensions simmer between the two neighbours over persistent [USN:L6N45Z09S TEXT:"haze"] from Indonesia's wildfires and Jakarta's decision to cut [USN:L6N46A01Z TEXT:"gas supplies"] to the city-state. Jakarta cut pipelined gas to Singapore by about 8% as of Saturday, saying it was safeguarding domestic supplies. The move came days after Indonesia's energy minister threatened to review [USN:L6N4680QU TEXT:"export contracts"] with countries "that are not cooperative and do not treat Indonesia with mutual respect". He did not name the countries. The visit by Singapore Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan, which Singapore has yet to confirm, comes as frustration builds in the city-state and neighbouring Malaysia over transboundary haze from Indonesia's [USN:L6N4610CY TEXT:"most intense"] forest fires in 11 years. [USN:L4N45T0LE TEXT:"Singapore generates"] up to 95% of its electricity from natural gas, and though the supply cut from Indonesia amounts to less than 2% of daily demand, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said on Sunday that he expects contract signatories to "honour their commitments". Indonesia's energy minister, Bahlil Lahadalia, [USN:L6N46C0FK TEXT:"hit back"] on Monday, saying the amount of gas now being supplied to Singapore met the minimum level stipulated under their agreement. "Our nation is a nation that honours contracts, rules. So don't teach Indonesia on how to honour contracts," Bahlil told a press conference, where he outlined details of gas exports to "so-called brothers and sisters". 'THIS ENTIRE REGION IS SUFFERING' Indonesia's fires have raged for months and driven up pollution and respiratory illness across the country, with thick haze also drifting into Singapore, Malaysia and East Timor. Singapore has not directly criticised the Indonesian government over the haze and has offered assistance, but it has sent notices to Indonesian companies it says are responsible for the blazes. Singapore Senior Minister K Shanmugam expressed disappointment last week over remarks made about the haze by an Indonesian official, who said that Indonesia's forests provided Singapore and Malaysia with oxygen. "Frankly, it is not right to say this when this entire region is suffering as a result of the bad behaviour of companies breaching regulations," Shanmugam said. "The people suffering the most are Indonesians themselves." Singapore's state investor Temasek and its sovereign wealth fund GIC were also on the defensive last week, rejecting allegations by a former Indonesian trade minister that they had pressured global index provider MSCI to consider demoting Indonesia's equities to [USN:L6N46208E TEXT:""standalone" market status"]. Indonesia's government has not commented on the allegation by the former minister. Veteran Singaporean diplomat Bilahari Kausikan called the gas cuts an "attempt at intimidation" but said they would be ineffectual. "The cost to Indonesia will far, far outlive any twinge we may feel," he posted on Facebook.

item.title: トランプ氏がミシシッピ州で演説、イラン戦争「まもなく終結」
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt
[コリンス（米ミシシッピ州） ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt

[コリンス（米ミシシッピ州） ２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、共和党の地盤であるミシシッピ州で演説し、自身が「好調」と評価する国内経済を根拠に同党の上院議員候補が勝利すると述べるとともに、原油価格がまもなく急落するという主張を繰り返した。

中間選挙を控えたこのところの集会で声がかすれていたトランプ氏は「神は毎日集会を開くために声帯をつくったわけではない」と述べた。

同氏は選挙戦終盤にテキサス、オハイオ、サウスカロライナ、フロリダ、アイオワを訪問する予定だが、世論調査の専門家によると、生活費の高騰に対する有権者の懸念が共和党に重くのしかかる可能性が高い。

トランプ氏は、イランとの戦争が原油価格を押し上げたことを認めたものの、イランの核兵器取得を阻止するためには、それほどの代償は安いものだと話し、「原油価格はもっと、もっと高くなると思っていた」と語った。

戦争については「事態はうまく収まっており、まもなく終結するだろう」とした。

item.title: 英小売価格、10月は前年比＋2.1％ 2年半超ぶり上昇率＝ＢＲＣ
item.description: [ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英小売協会（ＢＲＣ）が２７日発表した１０月の小売価格は前年同月比２．１％上昇した。...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英小売価格、10月は前年比＋2.1％　2年半超ぶり上昇率＝ＢＲＣ 11:37 配信

写真は3月27日、英ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Jaimi Joy

[ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英小売協会（ＢＲＣ）が２７日発表した１０月の小売価格は前年同月比２．１％上昇した。上昇率は９月の１．４％から加速し、２０２４年２月以来の大きさとなった。

ＢＲＣは、小売業者がコスト上昇の影響を吸収することが次第に困難になっていると警告した。

ＢＲＣのヘレン・ディキンソン最高責任者は「小売業者はこの２年間、押し寄せる大幅なコスト増を吸収してきたが、その防波堤が決壊し始めている」と述べた上で、ヒーリー財務相に対し、２８日に発表する就任後初の年次予算案で小売業者の不動産税負担と雇用コストを軽減するよう求めた。

１０月の食品価格上昇率は２．９％と、９月の２．５％から加速し、４月以来の高水準となった。常温食品の価格上昇率は３．２％と、９月の２．２％から加速し、２５年９月以来の高水準。

非食品の価格上昇率は１．７％と、０．８％から加速し、２３年１２月以来の高水準となった。家具、床材、住宅改修用品の価格が特に大きく上昇した。

イングランド銀行（中央銀行）のベイリー総裁は今月、２２年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後と異なり、これまでのところ、米国とイランの戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇を企業がおおむね吸収しており、利上げの必要性が低下していると述べていた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 10/27(火) 11:37 ロイター

item.title: 米通信ベライゾン、ＡＷＳと20億ドルＡＩ関連契約 契約者伸び予想引き上げ
item.description: ［２６日 ロイター］ - 米通信大手ベライゾン・コミュニケーションズ が２６日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期決算による...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米通信ベライゾン、ＡＷＳと20億ドルＡＩ関連契約　契約者伸び予想引き上げ 11:35 配信

写真はＡＷＳのＡＩデータセンターで作業する技術者。2025年10月、米インディアナ州ニューカーライルで撮影。 REUTERS/Noah Berger for AWS/File Photo

［２６日　ロイター］ - 米通信大手ベライゾン・コミュニケーションズ が２６日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期決算によると、携帯電話の月額課金契約者数は４０万６０００人増加し、調査会社ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想（２０万９４３９人増）を大きく上回った。料金プランの簡素化の効果で堅調な需要が見込めるとした。

・第３・四半期売上高は３４３億ドルで、ＬＳＥＧがまとめた市場予想の３４７億４０００万ドルを下回った。

・２６年通期の月額課金契約者数は１１０万―１２０万人増とし、従来予想（７５万―１００万人増）から上方修正した。調整後１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）も、従来予想（４．９９―５．０４ドル）から５．０４―５．０６ドルに引き上げた。

・ベライゾンは、アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウド部門であるアマゾン・ウェブ・サービス（ＡＷＳ）に対し、人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ向け光ファイバー接続の契約を２０億ドル超で結んだことも発表した。

・ダン・シュルマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は決算発表後の電話会見で、ダークファイバーまたはライトファイバーによる光ファイバー接続の提供に向け、他のハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）や、ＡＩ向けクラウドサービスに特化した「ネオクラウド」企業、大企業と交渉を進めていると明らかにした。

・シュルマン氏は米宇宙関連企業スペースＸの携帯電話市場参入計画については競合する地上網の構築に４―６年を要し、３０００億―５０００億ドルの費用がかかるとの見解を示した。

・スペースＸが携帯電話市場に参入した場合、ベライゾンは「熾烈な競争」を繰り広げることになるとした。

item.title: Cavaliers erase 15-point deficit, hand Timberwolves first loss in OT
item.description: Donovan Mitchell hit a go-ahead midrange jumper with 1:02 remaining in overtime as the host Cleveland Cavaliers rallied from a 15-point deficit to defeat the previously unbeaten Minnesota Timberwolves 127-125 on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Donovan Mitchell hit a go-ahead midrange jumper with 1:02 remaining in overtime as the host Cleveland Cavaliers rallied from a 15-point deficit to defeat the previously unbeaten Minnesota Timberwolves 127-125 on Monday night. Timberwolves superstar Anthony Edwards missed a wide-open 3-pointer with 3.9 seconds remaining that could have tied the game. Peyton Watson grabbed the rebound and made two free throws to push Cleveland's lead to 127-122. Edwards connected on a 3-pointer at the buzzer to finish with a season-high 47 points, his seventh career regular-season game with at least 47. The Timberwolves had won their first three contests by 20-plus points. Mitchell finished with 26 points and seven assists, while James Harden had 19 points and nine assists for the Cavaliers, who improved to 2-1. Evan Mobley added 18 points and 10 rebounds, and rookie Meleek Thomas scored 16 off the bench in his NBA debut. Jaden McDaniels had 14 points and Rudy Gobert collected 20 rebounds and five points, but missed all nine of his field goal attempts for the Timberwolves. LaMelo Ball had 11 points and seven turnovers. Edwards scored on consecutive possessions to give Minnesota a 108-104 lead with 1:45 remaining, but Harden's floater with 10 seconds left tied the game at 113. Watson, who finished with 15 points and eight rebounds, then blocked Edwards' attempt in the closing seconds to force overtime. The game featured four ties and 12 lead changes in the final 16 1/2 minutes. Cleveland used a 12-0 run midway through the third, fueled by eight points from Harden, to seize a 70-69 lead. It began a wild stretch that saw nine lead changes and two ties in the final 4 1/2 minutes of the period, ending in an 86-86 deadlock. The Timberwolves carried a 60-50 lead into the half, with Edwards pouring in 20 points, including a drive that gave them their largest lead, 54-39. Ball had nine points and Gobert grabbed eight rebounds, while Thomas had 10 to pace Cleveland. Edwards had 11 points and McDaniels added nine in the first as Minnesota seized a 29-16 lead. Thomas had eight points in six minutes, allowing the Cavaliers to trim their deficit to 31-24 after one. Edwards was listed as questionable due to right-knee injury management, but Minnesota coach Chris Finch said the team was evaluating it daily and did not consider it a long-term concern. The Timberwolves played their initial back-to-back set of the season after beating the Toronto Raptors 117-94 at home Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cooper Flagg returns to put up 29 as Mavericks keep Heat winless
item.description: Reigning Rookie of the Year Cooper Flagg returned from a one-game absence to score 29 points and dish 11 assists as the visiting Dallas Mavericks defeated the Miami Heat 113-109 on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Reigning Rookie of the Year Cooper Flagg returned from a one-game absence to score 29 points and dish 11 assists as the visiting Dallas Mavericks defeated the Miami Heat 113-109 on Monday night. Giannis Antetokounmpo posted his first triple-double for the Heat -- 29 points, 15 rebounds and 11 assists -- but Miami fell to 0-4 on the season. Flagg, who sat out Saturday due to a left shoulder injury, added six rebounds against the Heat. He shot 12-for-23 overall and 2-for-8 on 3-point attempts. Kyrie Irving, who was rested in Dallas' previous game, posted 18 points, six rebounds and six assists. The Mavericks, who have alternated losses and wins in their four games, got 20 points and nine rebounds from P.J. Washington plus 15 points from reserve Walter Clayton Jr. Mavericks rookie first-round pick Sergio de Larrea, who was coming off a 21-point game, was held scoreless in six minutes off the bench. He left the game in the second quarter because of a right knee strain, and he didn't return. Besides Antetokounmpo's contributions, Miami got 21 points from Davion Mitchell. All-Star center Bam Adebayo was held to eight points and eight rebounds, shooting 3-of-10 from the floor, including 0-for-5 from 3-point range. Andrew Wiggins had a 3-point attempt with 31.1 seconds left that would have put the Heat on top, but the shot missed. Following a timeout, Flagg drove for a layup with 10 seconds left that made it a four-point margin. Miami didn't lead until Tim Hardaway Jr. made a 3-pointer with 1:50 left in the first quarter. By the end of the period, the Heat were up 27-23 thanks to 52.4% shooting as compared to 29.6% for Dallas. The Heat stretched their second-quarter lead to 12 points, but Dallas went on a 17-4 run to close the half, and the Mavericks led 53-52 at intermission after a late Washington 3-pointer. Daniel Gafford's block of Antetokounmpo's dunk attempt was one of the quarter's highlights. Flagg led all first-half scorers with 13 points. For Miami, Antetokounmpo had 12 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists by the break. Antetokounmpo got even hotter in the third quarter, scoring 13 points as the Heat went up 84-83 by the end of the period. In the fourth, Dallas surged ahead 104-97 on a Flagg three-point play with 4:52 remaining, forcing Miami to call timeout. However, the Heat could not rally, extending their losing streak. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＧＰＩＦ、ＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄以外の投資機会模索が重要＝吉澤ＣＩＯ
item.description:
Miho Uranaka
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人（ＧＰＩＦ）の吉澤裕介最高投資...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＰＩＦ、ＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄以外の投資機会模索が重要＝吉澤ＣＩＯ 11:32 配信

写真はＧＰＩＦの看板。2018年11月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Toru Hanai

Miho Uranaka

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人（ＧＰＩＦ）の吉澤裕介最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は２７日、全国銀行協会のイベントに登壇し、株式運用ではＴＯＰＩＸをベンチマークとした運用を基本としつつ、「上場株式のアクティブ運用やオルタナティブ投資などを通じて、ベンチマーク外の企業にも幅広く投資機会を探ることが重要」との考えを示した。

ただ、ベンチマーク外への投資はベンチマークに対する追加的なリスクを能動的に取ることであるため、「そのリスクに見合う超過収益や分散効果が期待できるかを、国内外のさまざまな投資機会と比較して判断する必要がある」と語った。特にプライベート市場では、公正な評価や情報開示、パフォーマンスデータなど、投資判断を支える市場インフラの整備が重要だと指摘。日本のプライベート市場はとりわけ、データ整備が今後の課題だと語った。

吉澤氏によると、ＧＰＩＦの運用資産の約９８％は上場市場での運用だという。長期の資金を運用するため再現性が求められ、投資はデータや定量的な根拠に基づいて行う必要があると同氏は説明した。

上場市場とプライベート市場を一体で比較することは容易ではないが、まずは欧米並みの水準にデータを整えていくことが必要との認識を示した。そうした環境が整い、さまざまな投資機会がグローバルに比較評価されることで、日本市場が長期資金に継続的に選ばれる市場になっていくことを期待しているとした。

ＧＰＩＦの基本ポートフォリオは国内外株式と債券の４資産それぞれについて２５％を目標としており、資産ごとに５─６％ポイントの乖離が認められている。２０２５年度末のオルタナティブ資産の時価総額は５兆２０６７億円で積立金に占める割合は１．７％だった。

item.title: 消費減税の外食支援、来年4月以降も「緊要なら手を打つ」と片山財務相
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ２７日 ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相は２７日の衆院財務金融委員会で、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
消費減税の外食支援、来年4月以降も「緊要なら手を打つ」と片山財務相 11:30 配信

片山さつき財務相。１０月２１日撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Issei Kato）

Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２７日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相は２７日の衆院財務金融委員会で、来年４月から始まる食料品の消費税減税で影響を受ける外食産業について、「緊要性があれば手を打つ」と述べ、追加的支援を行う可能性を示した。近藤和也委員（中道）への答弁。

政府の減税案では店内飲食と持ち帰りにかかる税率の差が大幅に広がることになり、外食離れに拍車がかかるのではないかとの懸念が業界に広がっている。近藤委員がラーメンやそばなどテイクアウトになじみにくい業態への対応を求めたのに対し、片山財務相は自身が寿司やうなぎなどにかかわる業界団体で顧問を務めていることから外食産業の多様性はよく理解していると説明。その上で、必要であれば予備費の活用も含めて対策を講じる方針を示した。

来年４月から２年間、飲食料品の消費税率が引き下げられる減税法案では、持ち帰りにかかる税率が現行の８％から１％に下がるのに対し店内飲食は１０％のままとされている。

高市早苗首相は１６日の参院予算委員会で、プレミアム商品券や、「ＧｏＴｏイート」などの外食支援策を検討していると明らかにした。また、政府は９月の閣議決定で、外食業界向けに資金繰りの支援やテイクアウト導入の支援などを検討する方針を示している。

item.title: 中国工業部門利益、9月は14.4％増に加速 経済の二極化続く
item.description: [北京 ２７日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が２７日発表したデータによると、９月の工業部門企業利益は前年同月比１４．...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国工業部門利益、9月は14.4％増に加速　経済の二極化続く 11:29 配信

写真は2014年9月、遼寧省大連市で撮影。REUTERS/China Daily

[北京 ２７日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が２７日発表したデータによると、９月の工業部門企業利益は前年同月比１４．４％増加し、８月の４．２％増から加速した。ただ、経済の二極化が深まり、企業収益を引き続き圧迫している。

１─９月は１５．５％増で、伸び率は１─８月の１５．７％とほぼ変わらなかった。

業種間の格差は依然として顕著だった。コンピューター・通信・その他電子機器製造業の利益は１─９月に１０３．８％急増したのに対し、家具製造業は５１．３％減と最も振るわない業種の一つとなり、中国経済の不均衡を浮き彫りにした。

また、貿易黒字の拡大で欧州など貿易相手国・地域との摩擦が強まる中、輸出型企業は不確実性の増大に備えており、利益成長の持続性に影を落としている。

ただ、中信銀行国際の中国担当チーフエコノミスト、ディン・メン氏は、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連産業の急成長を理由に、先行きに楽観的な見方を示した。

「ＡＩのサプライチェーン（供給網）の発展が生み出す国内外の需要が、工業部門利益を支える重要な力になっていることを示している」とし、「世界的なＡＩ投資ブームが大きく反転しない限り、工業部門利益は引き続き速いペースで伸びると見込まれる」と語った。

国家統計局の担当者ユー・ウェイニン氏は、中国は引き続きマクロ経済政策を活用して成長を支え、内需拡大と供給の最適化を図ると述べ、従来の成長のけん引役を新たなものに置き換える取り組みを強調した。

工業部門企業利益の集計対象は、主要業務からの年間売上高が２０００万元（３００万ドル）以上の企業。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：「バブルはいつか崩壊」、中国ＡＩ株急落は世界市場への警鐘か 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：中国の緩和シグナルに一抹の警戒心、経済再構築は待ったなし コラム：海外マネーの中国離れ、習主席はじっとやり過ごすのが得策か アングル：中国ユニツリー、上場後に株価急落　バブルやＩＰＯ制度に懸念 最終更新: 10/27(火) 13:30 ロイター

item.title: Payton Pritchard ignites Celtics offense in win over Bulls
item.description: Payton Pritchard came off the bench to score a game-high 28 points to lead the Boston Celtics to a 134-99 victory over the visiting Chicago Bulls on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Payton Pritchard came off the bench to score a game-high 28 points to lead the Boston Celtics to a 134-99 victory over the visiting Chicago Bulls on Monday night. Pritchard made 7-of-10 shots from behind the 3-point arc. Jayson Tatum added 23 points, seven rebounds and six assists for Boston, which made 21 of its 44 3-point attempts and had a 54-40 edge in rebounds. Norman Powell led the Bulls with 20 points. Caleb Wilson tossed in 17, and Josh Giddey and Matas Buzelis each finished with 11. Leonard Miller had nine points and nine rebounds. Chicago was 33 of 84 from the field (39.2%). Each team committed 25 turnovers. Boston led 33-21 after one quarter, and had its largest lead in the first half, 44-28, with 9:12 left in the second quarter. Miller made a layup to cap a 12-0 run that cut Boston's lead to 44-40, but an 8-1 spurt put the Celtics up 54-44 with 3:27 remaining in the half. Boston led 66-54 at halftime. Tatum had 19 points, six rebounds and five assists in the first half. The Bulls were 18 of 46 from the field (39.1%) through the first two quarters. The Bulls were within seven points early in the second half, but Boston began to take control midway through the third quarter. An 11-1 run handed Boston a 95-71 lead, and three straight Pritchard 3-pointers extended Boston's advantage to 104-73 with 43.6 seconds remaining in the third. Boston led 105-75 after three quarters. Pritchard tossed in 19 points in the third, and he did most of his damage when Tatum was on the bench with foul trouble. The Celtics had a 112-80 lead following a Mike Conley 3-pointer with 8:36 to play, and led by as many as 40 points in the final quarter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Indian shares muted as oil stays near 6-month high, Fed rate decision in focus
item.description: Indian shares were little changed on Tuesday, pausing after previous session's gains, as oil remained near $115 a barrel and investors stayed cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
item.content:encoded: Indian shares were little changed on Tuesday, pausing after previous session's gains, as oil remained near $115 a barrel and investors stayed cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week. The benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.06% to 22,738.55, and the Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.16% to 73,497.28, as of 09:49 a.m. IST. Twelve of the 16 major sectors logged gains. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) rose 1.7% and 0.5%, respectively. Brent crude futures hovered near a six-month high after attacks on Saudi Arabia dampened hopes of an immediate easing of regional tensions. Higher oil prices hurt India, which imports most of its energy needs, as they can raise inflation, strain its fiscal deficit, and hit corporate profits. "Domestic markets are likely to be subdued as continued attacks on Saudi Arabia keep concerns over potential supply disruptions and inflation elevated," said Siddhartha Khemka, head of wealth management research at Motilal Oswal Financial Services. "Equities could remain muted until greater clarity emerges on the Middle East situation and central bank policy decisions." The Fed is expected to hold interest rates steady on Wednesday before resuming its tightening cycle with a December increase, according to a Reuters [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"poll"] of economists. IT index (.NIFTYIT) fell 1.8%. Infosys (INFY.NS) fell 2.8%, reversing the 1.1% rise in the previous session. The country's No. 2 software services firm by revenue lowered its revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2027 after reporting higher-than-expected September-quarter revenue after market hours on Friday. [USN:L3N46C0SM TEXT:"Tata Consumer Products"] (TACN.NS) rose 5.9% after reporting better-than-expected second-quarter profit, helped by steady demand for its packaged foods and beverages as the company expands beyond traditional tea and salt businesses. Sona BLW (SONB.NS) jumped 6.3% after posting a year-on-year rise in the September quarter revenue and profit. Astec Lifesciences (ASTE.NS) lost 2.5% after reporting a decline in quarterly profit.

item.title: Australia's AirTrunk bags $3 billion green loan to expand Sydney data centre
item.description: Blackstone-backed AirTrunk secured a A$4.25 billion ($2.98 billion) green loan to fund the continued development of its SYD3 campus in Western Sydney, supporting the expansion of digital infrastructure in the region.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Blackstone-backed (BX.N) AirTrunk secured a A$4.25 billion ($2.98 billion) green loan to fund the continued development of its SYD3 campus in Western Sydney, supporting the expansion of digital infrastructure in the region. Here are some details: Sydney-headquartered AirTrunk said the project, one of Australia's largest hyperscale data centres, will add secure and resilient infrastructure for cloud computing, AI and other digital services used by Australian businesses, governments and communities A consortium of 32 local and international financial institutions backed the green loan, making it one of the largest lending groups assembled for a data centre financing in Australia, the company said The green loan was underwritten by 14 lead banks, including DBS Bank (DBSM.SI) , MUFG Bank (8306.T) , National Australia Bank (NAB.AX) , HSBC (HSBA.L) and UOB (UOBH.SI) , the data centre operator said Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (8316.T) , HSBC and UOB acted as green loan coordinators, it added The green loan brings AirTrunk's total committed debt financing to about A$38.4 billion globally, including more than A$19.8 billion across its Australian projects Construction of the expanded SYD3 development is expected to be completed by mid-2028, and the project is likely to support more than 10,000 jobs across construction, trades, engineering, logistics and safety The financing comes despite growing investor caution around capital-intensive AI infrastructure projects AirTrunk's announcement comes as Australian data centre operator NextDC (NXT.AX) [USN:L4N4661TS TEXT:"last week said"] it would shelve all new development projects and land acquisitions for the foreseeable future and trimmed its revenue forecasts Firmus, another Australian data centre operator backed by Nvidia (NVDA.O) , [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"shelved its $5 billion IPO plan"] earlier this month as credit investors become increasingly selective toward AI-linked companies ($1 = 1.4249 Australian dollars)

item.title: Jay-Z to headline next year's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Jay-Z will headline the 2027 Super Bowl halftime show in February, the National Football League announced on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jay-Z will headline the 2027 Super Bowl halftime show in February, the National Football League announced on Monday. The show at the NFL championship game is the most-coveted showcase in the world of music. US television ratings for the halftime performance often top 100 million viewers and rank higher than the audience for the game itself. Iconic artists including the Rolling Stones, Beyonce, Madonna, Prince and Bruce Springsteen have taken the Super Bowl stage over the years. Puerto Rican rapper Bad Bunny headlined the show at the last Super Bowl. Next year's Super Bowl will take place on February 14 in Los Angeles. It will be broadcast on Walt Disney's ABC and ESPN television networks and will stream on Disney+ and the ESPN app. Jay-Z's company Roc Nation has produced the Super Bowl halftime show since 2019, and he plays a key role in selecting each year's performer. "For several years, we've had the privilege of working closely with Jay-Z and Roc Nation, and I've seen the extraordinary impact he has had on the Super Bowl Halftime Show," NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said in a statement. "When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that Jay-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him." Jay-Z is known for hits such as "99 Problems" and "Hard Knock Life." The 56-year-old rapper has also collaborated with artists including Alicia Keys on "Empire State of Mind" and his wife, Beyonce, on "Crazy in Love".

item.title: Bank of Korea warns country's chip exports could fall by up to $100 billion if AI spending slows
item.description: South Korea's semiconductor exports could fall by $50 billion to $100 billion compared with earlier forecasts if capital spending on artificial intelligence by major US technology firms slows next year, according to central bank data.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea's semiconductor exports could fall by $50 billion to $100 billion compared with earlier forecasts if capital spending on artificial intelligence by major US technology firms slows next year, according to central bank data. In a written response submitted to lawmaker Ahn Do-geol, the Bank of Korea (BOK) modelled a "pessimistic scenario" to assess the economic fallout if US tech giants curb their aggressive infrastructure outlays. Under the scenario, a sudden export shortfall would shave approximately 0.4 percentage point off South Korea's gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate next year, by driving the country's current account surplus well below the central bank's initial projection of $430 billion for 2027. The scenario assumed a 10% decline in Korean semiconductor unit prices. The assessment underscores growing anxiety over South Korea's heavy reliance on chips, which account for roughly half of its exports. The report said combined capital expenditure by five major US technology firms, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle, has been growing rapidly, from $40 billion last year to an estimated $80 billion this year, and is projected to reach $110 billion next year. However, the BOK cautioned that considerable uncertainty remains over the trajectory of AI demand and the broader memory chip business cycle.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted Houthi missiles, drones attacking kingdom
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said on Tuesday it intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles and drones launched by the Houthis towards two regions of Saudi Arabia, as the conflict between the kingdom and the Iran-aligned group intensifies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said on Tuesday it intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles and drones launched by the Houthis towards two regions of Saudi Arabia, as the conflict between the kingdom and the Iran-aligned group intensifies. The Houthis launched three ballistic missiles towards Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region, and four drones towards the country's Southern Region, the coalition said. Saudi Civil Defense issued early warning alerts for a potential hostile threat in the Eastern Region and in Kharj governorate, later saying the danger had passed in both areas. Saudi Arabia has intensified its strikes on the Houthis since the group captured strategic areas along Yemen's Red Sea coast last month, advancing towards [USN:L8N4520BL TEXT:"the Bab el-Mandeb Strait"], a key global shipping route for Gulf oil producers on the other side of the Arabian Peninsula from the Strait of Hormuz. The renewed fighting between the two sides has shattered a 2022 UN-brokered truce that largely halted attacks between the Saudi-led coalition, which backs Yemen's internationally recognised government, and [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"the Houthis"], who control the capital Sanaa. The escalation has also opened another front in the US-Israeli war on Iran .

item.title: リビア空域危険指定、国連機関が解除 航空会社の通過許可申請相次ぐ
item.description: ［トリポリ ２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［トリポリ　２６日　ロイター］ - 国連専門機関の国際民間航空機関（ＩＣＡＯ）は、リビアの内戦を受けて２０１５年に導入した空域の危険指定を解除した。リビア暫定政府の運輸省が２６日明らかにした。

運輸省によると、この決定は２３日に正式に出され、カタールのドーハで開かれた中東地域の民間航空当局者会議の開会式で、ＩＣＡＯのサラサール事務総長が表明した。

同省は「この措置は、近年のリビア民間航空部門における顕著な進展と、その能力に対する信頼の結果だ」と強調した。

国際航空各社からリビア空域の通過許可申請が相次いでいるという。同省の説明では、２６－２７年冬季シーズンの空域通過許可申請は１１月から月間６万１９６８便に達し、２５－２６年シーズンの月平均約２０００便から大幅に増加する見通し。「前例のない需要」で空域利用の増加により「多額の収入が見込まれる」とした。

リビアは１１年、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の支援を受けた蜂起によってカダフィ政権が崩壊した後、混乱が拡大。１４年には武装勢力間の内戦が勃発し、東西に分裂した統治体制が続いている。この内戦の影響で１４年にはトリポリ国際空港でエアバス機を含む最大２０機の航空機が損傷した。

現在リビア発着便を運航する航空会社は限られており、就航先もチュニジア、ヨルダン、トルコ、エジプト、サウジアラビア、スーダンなどに集中している。運輸省はＩＣＡＯの決定が加盟１９３カ国に通知され、各国で実施されると説明した。

item.title: Drew Doughty, Kings end Rangers' home-ice winning streak
item.description: Drew Doughty collected a goal and two assists on Monday for the visiting Los Angeles Kings, who scored three times in the first period and earned a 6-3 victory over the New York Rangers.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Drew Doughty collected a goal and two assists on Monday for the visiting Los Angeles Kings, who scored three times in the first period and earned a 6-3 victory over the New York Rangers. The result snapped New York's season-opening six-game home winning streak. Taylor Ward scored 1:15 into his season debut and Brandt Clarke also tallied as the Kings took a two-goal lead in the opening 4:52 by scoring on their first two shots against new Rangers goalie James Reimer. Doughty scored his first goal in 25 regular-season games as the Kings won for the third time in four games and earned their sixth straight win over New York. Former Ranger Artemi Panarin had the secondary assist on Doughty's first-period tally before scoring a power-play goal 90 seconds into the second period. Los Angeles' Mikey Anderson also scored in the second and Joel Edmundson capped it with an empty-net goal. Alex Laferriere contributed two assists as 12 players recorded a point for the Kings. Los Angeles goalie Darcy Kuemper made 23 saves. Reimer allowed three goals on eight shots in his debut for his ninth team. He tied Cam Talbot's NHL record for the most teams by a goalie. Dylan Garand relieved Reimer and allowed two goals on 17 shots. J.T. Miller scored in the first period, Adam Fox had a power-play tally in the second and Tye Kartye tallied in the third for the Rangers, who fell to 1-4-1 in their past six games and have allowed 18 goals during a three-game skid. Kartye added an assist. Los Angeles went ahead when Doughty spotted Ward cutting through the neutral zone. Ward split defensemen Sean Durzi and Marcus Pettersson and finished off a breakaway. During a long stretch of possession in the offensive zone on a delayed penalty drawn by Joel Armia, the Kings doubled the lead when Clarke went to the right edge of the crease and deflected a cross-ice pass from Scott Laughton into the net. After Miller deflected Kartye's pass with his left skate into an open net with 6:59 left in the opening period, Doughty made it 3-1 with a long drive from the left point 4 1/2 minutes later. Panarin's shot from the right circle went off Garand 14 seconds into a power play, and Anderson's goal off a faceoff 6:54 into the second opened a 5-1 lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: イスラエルできょう総選挙、ネタニヤフ首相に審判
item.description:
Steven Scheer Pesha Magid
[エルサレム ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steven Scheer　Pesha Magid

[エルサレム ２７日 ロイター] - ２７日に投票が行われるイスラエル総選挙で、ネタニヤフ首相は政治生命を懸けた戦いに臨む。有権者はイスラム組織ハマスによる２０２３年の奇襲とパレスチナ自治区ガザでの戦闘、イランとの戦争、深まる国際的孤立を踏まえて同氏の指導力に審判を下す。

ただ、通算在任期間が１９年と同国最長のネタニヤフ氏は、幾度も政治的危機を乗り切ってきた手ごわい存在だ。ナショナリズム色の濃い政治が一段と定着していることに加え、政党が分立するイスラエルの政治体制の下では、同氏が政権樹立に最も有利な位置に立つ可能性がある。

世論調査では、ネタニヤフ氏率いるリクードと右派の協力政党が、アイゼンコット元軍参謀総長率いる対抗勢力と接戦を繰り広げている。アイゼンコット氏は安全保障政策で強硬派とされ、右派と中道の支持を集めている。

ネタニヤフ氏は戦時下での指導力や、イスラエルと共にイランとの戦争に加わったトランプ米大統領との関係を前面に掲げて選挙戦を展開している。ネタニヤフ氏は２５日、トランプ氏が「イランの脅威をついに排除する」ための行動を取る用意があると述べたが、それはネタニヤフ氏自身が権力の座にとどまる場合に限られるとした。

アイゼンコット氏は、ネタニヤフ氏が「恐怖をあおり、うそと脅しに頼る選挙運動」を展開していると非難。トランプ氏が「国民に選ばれたいかなる指導者とも全面的に協力する」と確信していると述べた。

ネタニヤフ氏は、政権樹立のために再び極右指導者のベングビール氏やスモトリッチ氏に依存する可能性がある。両氏はパレスチナ人に対する暴力を扇動したとして、一部の西側諸国から制裁を受けているが、ベングビール氏率いる「ユダヤの力」は世論調査で支持を伸ばしている。

ネタニヤフ、アイゼンコット両氏とも、政権獲得への明確な道筋は見えていない。いずれも連立政権を樹立できなければ、ネタニヤフ氏が２７年の再選挙まで暫定首相として続投する可能性がある。

投票は午前７時（日本時間午後２時）から午後１０時（同２８日午前５時）まで行われる。

＜１０月７日の責任＞

ネタニヤフ氏の反対派の多くにとって今回の選挙は、イスラエル史上最悪の犠牲を出した２３年１０月７日の治安上の失策に対する責任が争点となる。

教育省職員でアイゼンコット氏の支持者であるマリ・ハジャジさんは「最も重要なのは国家調査委員会の設置だ。そこから私たちの癒やしが始まるからだ」と述べた。

リサ・トルトーさんは、ネタニヤフ氏が退陣し「新政権が発足して、ビビ（ネタニヤフ氏）が世界中のユダヤ人やイスラエル、イスラエルのイメージに与えた損害の一部でも修復してほしい」と語った。

一方、リクード支持者のノフ・ガバイさんは、１０月７日の責任がネタニヤフ氏にあるとの見方を否定し、同氏は「イスラエルという国にふさわしい人物だ」と指摘。「ネタニヤフ氏は最善の形で戦争を指揮した」と述べた。

item.title: Yen slips ahead of central bank bonanza, dollar firms on tech rebound
item.description: The Japanese yen eased against the US dollar on Tuesday, further eroding last week's safe-haven gains, underpinned by a risk-on mood and a weaker euro ahead of key central bank meetings this week that will influence the global rates outlook.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Japanese yen eased against the US dollar on Tuesday, further eroding last week's safe-haven gains, underpinned by a risk-on mood and a weaker euro ahead of key central bank meetings this week that will influence the global rates outlook. The yen was 0.16% weaker at 157.73 per dollar, inching further away from the one-month high it touched last week ahead of the Bank of Japan policy decision later this week. The yen had lost ground on Monday too. The BOJ is set to keep interest rates steady at 1.25% in a [USN:L3N46C02N TEXT:"two-day meeting"] concluding on Friday, but signal its readiness to continue raising borrowing costs on mounting price pressures. A key gauge of Japan's service-sector inflation [USN:L3N46D002 TEXT:"rose"] 3.7% in September from a year earlier, data showed on Tuesday, a sign of increasing price pressures that will likely keep the central bank on track for further interest rate hikes. "We expect the BOJ will conclude that the underlying rate of consumer price inflation is at a level generally consistent with the 2% price stability target," analysts at MUFG said in a note. However, simply touching the target once is not enough, the analysts said, adding that the BOJ will now shift from a focus on the downside risks to inflation to a stance of monitoring risks in both directions. The yen was among the best-performing major currencies last week, as AI jitters in the equity market spurred a haven rush into the currency. Markets price slightly better-than-even odds of a December BOJ hike, so there is plenty of room for a rebound in the yen should Governor Ueda strike a hawkish note, said Ebury analysts in a note. "We still favour another hike at the last meeting of the year, though whether the BOJ will be prepared to commit to that just yet is unclear." Apart from the BOJ, four other major central banks will announce policy decisions this week. The BOJ's meeting follows that of the Fed, which is seen skipping a hike at its two-day meeting concluding on Wednesday. The European Central Bank is also set to keep rates unchanged at 2.5% on Thursday. New Zealand's and Canada's central banks are expected to raise rates this week. DOLLAR FIRMS ON RISK-APPETITE REVIVAL The dollar index held steady near a one-week high on Tuesday at 102.04 as a tech-led rebound on Wall Street revived appetite for risk, while investors await megacap earnings and the US midterm elections. Risk appetite returned overnight after Anthropic's IPO filing and Meta's (META.O) $95 billion equity plan rekindled the artificial intelligence trade. The dollar was also underpinned by a weaker euro , which fell to a near two-week low against the greenback as worries over France's fiscal health piled pressure on the single currency. The euro last fetched $1.1165, down about 1.4% this month. A selloff in French government bonds that drove the country's debt-risk premium to its highest since the 2011 sovereign debt crisis has rekindled concerns about financial stress across the euro zone. The Brazilian real stabilised after it fell sharply against the US dollar after President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva [USN:L2N46B01X TEXT:"won"] a historic fourth term on Sunday against Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: 米ＬＣＣジェットブルー、第3四半期は赤字拡大 燃料高に追い付けず
item.description:
Doyinsola Oladipo Nandan Mandayam
[２６日 ロイター] - 米格安航空会社（ＬＣＣ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＬＣＣジェットブルー、第3四半期は赤字拡大　燃料高に追い付けず 11:07 配信

写真はジェットブルーのロゴ。2023年6月、フランス・パリ近郊のル・ブルジェ空港で撮影。 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Doyinsola Oladipo　Nandan Mandayam

[２６日　ロイター] - 米格安航空会社（ＬＣＣ）ジェットブルー航空が２６日発表した第３・四半期決算は、損失が予想以上に拡大した。事業再編への懸念を背景に同社債は急落しているが、通年の座席収入の伸び率見通しを引き上げた。

純損益は１株当たり０．６０ドルの赤字。赤字幅は前年同期の０．４０ドルから拡大し、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の０．５５ドルを上回った。

９月末時点の総負債は８３億９０００万ドルで、前四半期の約８５億ドルから減少した。ただ、現金および現金同等物は１６億６０００万ドルから１２億６０００万ドルに減った。流動性は２２億ドル。

第３・四半期の燃料価格は１ガロン当たり平均３．９１ドルで、前年同期比５７％上昇。先月示した予測（３．９６ドル）をわずかに下回ったが、価格決定力を示す指標であるユニットレベニュー（有効座席マイル当たりの旅客収入）は１８．４％の上昇にとどまり、燃料費の急騰に追いついていない。

米国の航空各社はこれまでコストや収益予測を困難にしている燃料価格の変動に対処するため、運賃値上げ、受託手荷物手数料の引き上げ、運航便数の抑制によって収益拡大を図ってきた。

ジェットブルーは通年の座席収入の伸び率見通しを、従来の１０－１２．５％から１３．５－１４．５％に上方修正し、高運賃の維持に対する自信を示した。

item.title: Brandon Miller scores career-high 39 as Hornets beat Wizards
item.description: Brandon Miller scored a career-high 39 points and the Charlotte Hornets held off the visiting Washington Wizards for Monday night's 110-103 victory for their first back-to-back wins of the young season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Brandon Miller scored a career-high 39 points and the Charlotte Hornets held off the visiting Washington Wizards for Monday night's 110-103 victory for their first back-to-back wins of the young season. Miller made 15 of 28 shots from the field, including five 3-pointers. Naz Reid added 18 points and 12 rebounds for Charlotte, while Grayson Allen scored 15 off the bench, including seven from the free-throw line. Moussa Diabate chipped in 11 points and 17 rebounds. Anthony Davis scored 29 points and grabbed 10 rebounds for the Wizards, hitting three of Washington's nine 3-point attempts. Trae Young added 22 points and 10 assists, Kyshawn George posted 20 points and Alex Sarr had 12 points. The Wizards lost the battle on the boards, especially as the Hornets grabbed 20 offensive rebounds. Miller had horrid shooting outings in the first two games of the season and now he has eclipsed the 30-point mark in consecutive games. Miller's previous career high was 38 points against the Detroit Pistons on Nov. 21, 2024. Charlotte stormed to a 54-44 halftime lead despite a sluggish start to the final game of a three-game homestand. The Hornets carried a 12-point lead into the fourth quarter before Washington mounted a late comeback, getting as close as 103-100. Young went 10 of 20 from the field but attempted only one free throw. The teams combined for 32 free-throw attempts. The Hornets were whistled for only 15 fouls. The Wizards received only 17 points from their reserves. The start of the game didn't suggest the Hornets would have a big night offensively. Washington led 21-19 at the end of the first quarter, while Charlotte shot 33.3% from the field and went 1-for-11 from 3-point range. The Hornets played again without injured Kon Knueppel, Coby White and Grant Williams. --Field Level Media

item.title: 焦点：「バブルはいつか崩壊」、中国ＡＩ株急落は世界市場への警鐘か
item.description: ［２６日 ロイター］ - 世界のハイテク株の値動きが不安定になっているが、中国では既に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が急落に見舞...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
焦点：「バブルはいつか崩壊」、中国ＡＩ株急落は世界市場への警鐘か 11:00 配信

写真は宇樹科技（ユニツリー）の人型ロボット（ヒューマノイド）。9月8日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

［２６日　ロイター］ - 世界のハイテク株の値動きが不安定になっているが、中国では既に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が急落に見舞われた。ＡＩ需要への懸念や中国製品に対する輸出規制強化を背景に、これまでの高騰した企業価値が崩れつつあるためだ。

中国本土のＡＩ・半導体関連の主力銘柄で構成される上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け株式市場｢科創板」の科創板５０指数は、４カ月足らずで約４０％下落。時価総額は約４８００億ドルも失われた。これは足場がぐらついてきた世界の株式市場への警鐘となるかもしれない。さらに中国政府がＡＩブームの資金源として家計資金を株式市場へ呼び込もうとする取り組みにも冷や水を浴びせている。

今回の急落は、中国当局による景気刺激策への期待で約２年前から続いてきた上昇相場に急ブレーキをかけた。急騰と暴落を繰り返す従来の相場から脱却し、持続的に上昇する「スロー・ブル（緩やかな強気相場）」を形成するという政府の取り組みも停滞している。

代表的な優良株指数のＣＳＩ３００指数も、６月につけた高値から約２０％下落した。

北京のファンドマネジャー、ドン・バオチェン氏は「株式市場は投機的な熱狂相場へと変質した。そして今、そのバブルが崩壊しつつある」と指摘する。

こうした値下がりは、欧米やアジアの他市場を上回る勢いで上昇した中国株に生じた反動の大きさを表している。米国でＡＩ関連株が主導する調整によりナスダック総合指数に生じた過去最高値からの下落は約６％だった。

市場関係者に話を聞くと、明確な売り材料はなかった。しかし株価の過熱感や納税負担に加え、米国などが中国製機器のデータセンター導入を禁止する可能性への警戒感が下押し要因になったという。

ゴールドマン・サックスによれば、中国本土Ａ株と香港Ｈ株市場はＡＩ関連銘柄が時価総額の約４２％、売買代金の約５７％を占めている。こうしたウエートの大きいＡＩ関連銘柄の急落は、個人投資家の多い中国市場に幅広い損失をもたらした。

＜個人に人気の銘柄急落＞

ロボットメーカーの宇樹科技（ユニツリー）株は、上場時に個人投資家から約８０００倍の需要を集めたものの、８月の取引開始後から株価は半値近くまで下落。半導体メーカーのＣＸＭＴはこの１カ月で時価総額の４分の１超を失った。さらに半導体設計会社の沐曦集成電路（ＭｅｔａＸ）と摩爾線程（Ｍｏｏｒｅ Ｔｈｒｅａｄｓ）は、それぞれ上場直後に７００％、４００％もの上昇を記録したが、７月以降は株価が半分程度まで下がっている。

中国南部・海南省で事業を営む個人投資家のチェン・ウェンシェン氏は、宇樹科技に国有系ファンドが出資していたことなどから、政府の後押しがあると考えて投資した。ところが現在は友人たちとともに損失を抱えているという。

政府の支援を受けた投資テーマがこれほど不調に終わったことへの失望感から、多くの投資家はディフェンシブ資産へと資金を移している。今後はハイテク企業の株式による資金調達にも逆風となりそうだ。

光通信部品メーカーの中際旭創（Ｚｈｏｎｇｊｉ Ｉｎｎｏｌｉｇｈｔ）と新易盛（Ｅｏｐｔｏｌｉｎｋ）の株価も、６月から７月にかけて付けた高値からおよそ６０％下落した。背景には、米政府が両社による米国データセンター向け供給を制限する方向で動いていることもある。

科創板５０指数の予想株価収益率（ＰＥＲ）は低下したとはいえ、依然として過去１２カ月利益ベースで約１００倍に達している。ピーク時の約２５０倍からは大きく低下したが、ナスダック１００指数の約３０倍と比較するとなお高水準で、投資家の間では下落がさらに続くとの懸念が根強い。

香港の蓮華資産管理でマネージングパートナー兼最高投資責任者を務めるホン・ハオ氏は「今回の状況により、上場を目指す多くの企業の動きに待ったがかかるだろう」と話す。

＜あらゆるバブルはいつか崩壊＞

今回の熱狂とその後の急落は、中国当局がレバレッジ取引や高頻度取引の規制を強化し、市場の変動を抑えながら投資家リターンを高めようとしてきた方針とは対照的な展開となった。国有系投資家は相場過熱を抑えるため、上昇局面では売り手に回っていた。

中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）はロイターの問い合わせに即座には回答しなかった。ただ呉清主席が今月初め、市場関係者との会合を開いて資本市場改革に向けた意見を聴取したと、証監会はウェブサイトで明らかにしている。

投資業界では一連のブームが市場構造をゆがめたとの声も上がる。北京の千創資本のパートナー、レオ・ワン氏は「主要指数におけるテクノロジー企業の時価総額比率、いわゆる『技術含有量』ばかりを重視すると、資本の流れが本来あるべき姿から逸脱し、ねじ曲げられる」と指摘。その結果として特定分野では深刻なバブルが生まれ、他の分野からは資金が流出する事態となったと述べた。

一部の市場関係者はこの急落を前向きに捉えている。長期的な市場改革の流れが損なわれるわけではなく、近年は株主還元や配当重視の姿勢が強まるなど、市場改善の成果も出始めているためだ。

ＨＳＢＣの調査によると、アジアの投資ファンドは過去３カ月間、中国株を売り越しているものの、依然として中国株の保有比率をベンチマーク以上に維持している。またゴールドマン・サックスは今月公表した改定後の推奨銘柄リストの中で、中際旭創やＣＸＭＴを含む数十の中国ＡＩ関連銘柄を引き続き有望株に挙げている。ＢＮＰパリバ証券のストラテジスト、ウィリアム・ブラットン氏も、慎重な銘柄選別を前提に買いの好機が存在するとの見解を示した。

それでも中国本土の投資家の多くは、さらに株価が下がるのを待つか、別の業種に投資先を移す姿勢を強めている。上海卓鋳投資のパートナー、ワン・ジュオ氏は「半導体メーカーやＡＩ関連企業も、最終的には他の中国メーカーと同様に価格競争へ巻き込まれるだろう。例外はない。あらゆるバブルはいずれ崩壊する」と言い切った。

item.title: Russia, Ukraine begin localised ceasefire to allow for humanitarian operation in Oleshky
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have started a localised ceasefire to allow for a humanitarian operation to begin in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, both sides said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia and Ukraine have started a localised ceasefire to allow for a humanitarian operation to begin in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, both sides said on Tuesday. Russia's defence ministry said on Telegram it stopped shelling in the direction of the Ukrainian city of Kherson from 4 a.m. Moscow time (0100 GMT) to prepare for the humanitarian operation in Oleshky, just across the Dnipro River from Kherson. Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's parliament commissioner for human rights, confirmed in a Facebook post the ceasefire has started at the same time. "As head of the Ukrainian negotiating team, I confirm that the Ukrainian side is honoring its commitments," he wrote. Russia and Ukraine have [USN:L1N46911P TEXT:"agreed"] to a localised ceasefire around the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine, an arrangement that will enable aid deliveries and allow evacuations from a frontline town suffering acute shortages of food and medicine. Oleshky [USN:L2N46C0BA TEXT:"lies"] on the eastern bank of the Dnipro in Ukraine's southern region of Kherson, opposite the city of Kherson, which is held by Ukrainian forces. Russian troops seized Oleshky during the first days of their February 2022 invasion and have controlled it ever since. The White House said last week that US first lady Melania Trump helped to secure the Oleshky ceasefire. Elsewhere in Ukraine, a Russian missile [USN:L2N46C0Y8 TEXT:"attack"] on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Monday killed at least one person and injured 10, including students at a dormitory, with the attacks [USN:L2N46C0SM TEXT:"also"] killing and injuring people in the cities of Kharkiv and Pavlohrad. New explosions were heard on Tuesday morning in Kyiv, a Reuters witness said.

item.title: 豪、重要鉱物戦略見直し 精製・加工を一段と重視
item.description: [シドニー ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シドニー ２７日 ロイター] - オーストラリアのキング資源相は２７日、重要鉱物戦略を見直し、精製・加工を一段と重視する方針を示した。投資誘致競争の激化や、サプライチェーン（供給網）に対する継続的な懸念が背景。

キング氏は見直し後の戦略について、「経済面・戦略面でより大きな価値」を獲得することに重点を置き、重要鉱物産業の次の発展段階を導くものになると説明。

「重要鉱物の加工・精製を一段と重視する。特に、オーストラリアが比較優位を持つ、あるいは確立できる分野に重点を置く」と述べた。

キング氏は、豪政府が２０２３年に当初の重要鉱物戦略を公表して以降、市場環境は厳しさを増し、投資誘致競争が激化したほか、供給網の脆弱性も引き続き懸念材料となっていると指摘。

「オーストラリアはこの戦略により、長期的に最大の価値を生み出せる分野に引き続き注力できる」と述べ、重要鉱物産業の成長は「豪単独で実現するものではない」との認識を示した。

item.title: China's industrial profit growth picks up amid deepening economic divergence
item.description: China's industrial profits grew at a faster pace in September, though a deepening divergence across the economy weighed on business earnings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's industrial profits grew at a faster pace in September, though a deepening divergence across the economy weighed on business earnings. Profits at industrial firms rose 14.4% from a year earlier last month, quickening from a 4.2% increase in August, data from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed on Tuesday. Profits were up 15.5% in the first nine months of this year, largely unchanged from the 15.7% increase in the January-August period. The sectoral divide remained pronounced, with profits in the computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing category more than doubling over the nine-month period, whereas profits in the furniture manufacturing sector fell by more than half, making it one of the worst performers. Also casting a shadow over the sustainability of profit growth, export-oriented firms are bracing for greater uncertainty as expanding trade surpluses stoke tensions with trading partners, particularly Europe. However, CITIC Bank International's chief China economist, Ding Meng, expressed optimism about the outlook because of the rapid growth in AI-related industries. "This suggests that domestic and external demand generated by the development of the AI supply chain has become a key force supporting industrial profits," he said. "Barring a major reversal in the global AI investment boom, industrial profits are expected to continue growing at a rapid pace." A stronger-than-expected 4.5% expansion in [USN:L1N46501H TEXT:"third-quarter"] GDP put China within reach of its annual growth target of 4.5% to 5.0%, but disparities across different parts of the economy suggest the recovery remains unbalanced, with persistent weakness in some sectors continuing to erode corporate profitability. That pressure has become increasingly visible at the company level. Net profit growth at the world's largest electric vehicle battery maker, CATL (300750.SZ) , [USN:L6N4660TN TEXT:"slowed"] sharply in the past quarter, as intense competition in the EV battery market squeezed margins at a time when China's auto sales were in a downturn. China will continue to leverage macroeconomic policies to support growth, expand domestic demand and optimize supply, said NBS statistician Yu Weining, underscoring a push to replace traditional growth drivers with new ones. Industrial profit figures cover firms with yearly revenue of at least 20 million yuan ($3.0 million) from main operations. ($1 = 6.6702 Chinese yuan)

item.title: 中国課税強化、運用事業の資金流入に影響なし＝ＪＰモルガンＡＭ
item.description: [シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのシンガポール・東南アジア・インド担当最...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国課税強化、運用事業の資金流入に影響なし＝ＪＰモルガンＡＭ 10:51 配信

２０１５年１月、浙江省杭州市で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/China Daily）

[シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのシンガポール・東南アジア・インド担当最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、アヤズ・エブラヒム氏は、中国政府による海外所得への課税強化について、アジアにおける同社への資金流入に影響は出ていないと述べた。

シンガポールでのインタビューで、流入は堅調に推移していると説明した。ただ、具体的な数字は示さなかった。

海外所得の申告期限が迫る中、中国の一部富裕層は海外信託の解消や株式売却に動いているほか、国籍を変更するケースもある。証券会社は課税強化が香港株やシンガポールの銀行株の下落要因だとしている。シンガポールの銀行は、中国や東南アジアの富裕層からの資金流入の恩恵を受けてきた。

エブラヒム氏は、課税強化は資金の流れにとって一時的な障害にとどまるのではないかと指摘。中国は成長率が３％でも多額の富を生み出すとして、アジアの富の拡大に注力する方針を強調した。

同社の運用資産は４兆６０００億ドル。このほど、シンガポールに２人体制のトレーディングデスクを開設した。２０２７年第１・四半期までに、人員は同氏が赴任した２４年４月比で２０─２５％増加する見通しだという。

item.title: ＧＭＯ、利用者にＰＣ電源切るよう呼びかけ 正午が攻撃予告期限
item.description: [東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＧＭＯインターネットグループは２７日、ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）自動売買サービスに不正...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭＯ、利用者にＰＣ電源切るよう呼びかけ　正午が攻撃予告期限 10:49 配信

２０２５年１２月、東京ビッグサイトで開催された「国際ロボット展」で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Manami Yamada）

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＧＭＯインターネットグループは２７日、ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）自動売買サービスに不正アクセスしたとみられる攻撃者からランサムウエア（身代金要求型ウイルス）攻撃の予告があったことを受け、期限となる同日正午前にパソコンの電源を切るよう利用者に呼びかけた。

ＧＭＯは一部利用者の端末を預かり、ランサムウエアを含むマルウエア（悪意あるソフト）が実際に仕掛けられているかどうかなどを確認するとともに、対処方法を模索している。トレンドマイクロなどのセキュリティー企業やＩＴ企業から協力の申し出を受けているという。

ＧＭＯによると、ランサムウエア攻撃の予告期限は正午。利用者に対し、データをバックアップした上でネットワークを切断し、ＰＣの電源を切って電源コードを抜くよう呼びかけている。

ＧＭＯはＦＸ自動売買サービスが不正アクセスを受け、利用者からの問い合わせにより今月１９日に調査を開始した。一部の利用者から身に覚えのない取引が行われたとの報告が寄せられ、２２日に警察へ相談した。

熊谷正寿代表によると、これまでに攻撃者から５０００万ドル（約８０億円）を暗号資産で支払うよう要求があった。また、読売新聞などの報道によると、攻撃者は日本語のサイトで、２７日正午までに１００万ドル（約１億６０００万円）を支払うよう要求している。

ＧＭＯは、国が主導して相手を無力化する「能動的サイバー防御」の適用を政府に求めている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：「バブルはいつか崩壊」、中国ＡＩ株急落は世界市場への警鐘か 焦点：ディーゼル高騰が米中間選挙の争点に、トランプ氏の矢継ぎ早の対策も効果見えず アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める アングル：ネタニヤフ氏、旧来の選挙戦術で「守護者」演出　ハマス攻撃で信頼回復に苦戦も 最終更新: 10/27(火) 11:42 ロイター

item.title: メルツ独首相と28日会談、日本製ＥＶ排除巡る懸念伝える＝経産相
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は２７日の閣議後会見で、２８日から来...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
メルツ独首相と28日会談、日本製ＥＶ排除巡る懸念伝える＝経産相 10:46 配信

ドイツのメルツ首相。１０月２０日、ベルリンで撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Lisi Niesner）

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は２７日の閣議後会見で、２８日から来日するドイツのメルツ首相と同日都内で会談すると明らかにした上で、欧州連合（ＥＵ）が検討する欧州製電気自動車（ＥＶ）の優遇措置案に関し、日本製が導入支援対象外となり欧州市場から排除されるのは好ましくないとして「わが国の懸念をしっかりと伝えたい」と述べた。

赤沢氏は「ＥＵと日本は相互補完性を有する信頼できるパートナーであり、ＥＶを含め日本産の製品がＥＵ製と同等に扱われることは双方の産業競争力の維持強化にとって極めて重要だ」と指摘。日本企業が不利益を被ることのないよう適切な対応を強く求めていくとした。販売台数などでは米国市場には及ばないものの「欧州市場にも日本の自動車メーカーはかなりの輸出を行ったり、 現地生産したりと相当程度の経済活動をしている」とし、不利益は「看過できるものではない」と強調した。

一方、サイバー攻撃の多発を受け、中小企業や小規模事業者向けのサイバーセキュリティ―特別相談窓口を同日から各都道府県に設置すると発表した。高市早苗首相から、相談窓口の抜本的拡充や、プッシュ型での情報提供の指示があったという。赤沢氏は「引き続き、全国の中小、小規模事業者の個別の相談にきめ細かく対応していく」とした。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：ルノー、ＥＶ新会社ＩＰＯ中止は「災い転じて福」か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：静かに進むガソリン離れ、中国製ＥＶの世界展開が後押しか 焦点：中国の省エネシフト加速、燃料需要が急減　ＥＶ普及など 最終更新: 10/27(火) 12:38 ロイター

item.title: Asian stocks surge as Anthropic IPO lifts sentiment ahead of earnings, central banks
item.description: Asian stocks surged on Tuesday as AI bellwether Anthropic's eagerly anticipated IPO filing lifted risk appetite ahead of tech earnings that will be a test for the AI trade, and central bank meetings that will influence near-term interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Ankur Banerjee
item.content:encoded: Asian stocks surged on Tuesday as AI bellwether [USN:L6N46C148 TEXT:"Anthropic's"] eagerly anticipated [USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"IPO filing"] lifted risk appetite ahead of tech earnings that will be a test for the AI trade, and central bank meetings that will influence near-term interest rates. Claude-owner Anthropic disclosed steep loss and red-hot revenue growth in its filing for a US initial public offering, as investors increasingly dissect the potential payoff from massive AI spending and its profitability. Also boosting sentiment was Meta Platforms' (META.O) plans to raise up to $95 billion in its largest-ever equity fundraising. The currency markets are muted ahead of policy decisions from the [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"Federal Reserve"], European Central Bank and [USN:L3N46C02N TEXT:"Bank of Japan"], with economists expecting all three to stand pat on interest rates, leaving the focus on comments from policymakers to gauge the rates outlook. In stocks, tech-heavy South Korea's KOSPI (.KS11) gained more than 4% in early trading while Japan's Nikkei (.N225) was 1.9% higher. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) rose 1.2%. Nasdaq futures was up 0.4% after US chip stocks (.SOX) rose 2.8% in overnight trade, clocking its biggest one-day jump in a month. European stock futures dipped 0.23%. More than a third of S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report earnings this week, including hyperscalers Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) . "Given the increased AI scrutiny of late and circular arrangements, investors will want evidence that demand is broadening beyond these interconnected relationships to support the continued infrastructure expansion," said Anthony Saglimbene, Ameriprise's chief market strategist. "Investors need confidence that aggressive capex spending reflects durable business needs and that profitability will hold up as new infrastructure comes into service," he said. Brent crude futures eased 0.7% to $114.95 a barrel, drifting away from a six-month high as investors weighed the potential for a resolution in the US-Israeli war with Iran, keeping supply fears at bay though sentiment remained fragile. Nick Twidale, chief market strategist at ATFX Global, said supply remains the key concern, and any developments that threaten physical exports could see Brent quickly retest recent highs and potentially push back towards $120. The nearly eight-month-old war has rippled across the Middle East, sending oil prices higher, stoking inflation worries and upending the global interest rates outlook, sharpening the focus on the central bank decisions this week. Fed [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"policymakers"] have telegraphed they will not raise short-term borrowing costs again this week, but with inflation concerns still front and centre, investors believe a rate-hike pause will not last for long. Traders are pricing in a hike from the Fed in December. "Can we expect (US) growth to hold up in an environment of higher rates?," Geng Ngarmboonanant, head of macro and policy, multi-asset solutions, J.P. Morgan Asset Management, said. "We think yes. We believe the US economy is going to be able to manage through higher interest rates." The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note was steady at 4.992%, staying below 5% which it breached in September as investors scurried to Treasuries for safety during stock market tumult over AI worries. The Japanese yen has been the haven of choice in currency markets and was last at 157.72 per dollar ahead of the BOJ decision on Friday. The Japanese central bank is widely expected to declare victory in a nearly 14-year battle to hit its 2% inflation target on Friday and emphasise the risk that prices could overshoot, signalling the chance of an interest rate hike as soon as December. In commodities, gold eased a touch and was last at $4,013.70 per ounce.

item.title: Explosions heard in Ukraine's Kyiv, Reuters witness says
