item.title: Israel election: What happens after polls close?
item.description: Israel holds a parliamentary election on Tuesday, its first since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 that shook the country and plunged the Middle East into turmoil.
item.dc:creator: Maayan Lubell
item.content:encoded: Israel holds a parliamentary election on Tuesday, its first since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 that shook the country and plunged the Middle East into turmoil. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's hold on power is at stake, with centrist rivals promising to usher in a new era, but it might take time before clear results are known. WHEN WILL WE KNOW WHO WON? It is likely this will be known within a few hours of polls closing, but it could take days or even weeks to become clear. Voting starts at 7 a.m. (0500 GMT) and ends at 10 p.m. (2000 GMT), when Israeli TV channels will air exit polls giving the first indications of the outcome. The election results will then start coming in. A clear picture may emerge quickly but if no party or group of parties has a clear parliamentary majority, it could take much longer. The final tally is expected by October 30 and official election results are formally published a week after the election, on November 4. WHY IS IT SO COMPLICATED? Elections to the 120-seat Knesset are meant to be held every four years but early elections have been frequent. The Knesset seats are allocated by proportional representation to national party lists, with parties needing to pass a threshold of 3.25% of the national vote to secure seats. About a dozen parties are widely thought to have a chance of crossing the threshold, so the final tally and seat allocation will take time. WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE RESULTS ARE PUBLISHED? After the final tally is in, President Isaac Herzog will consult party leaders on whom they want as prime minister and then tap the candidate he believes has the best chance of forming a government. That nominee has up to 42 days to form a government. No single party in Israel has ever won an outright majority, so governments are formed by a coalition of parties, and negotiations on forming a government often take weeks. Every Knesset seat counts and small parties can have a big impact by becoming kingmakers. If the nominee fails, others can get a chance to try. If no government emerges, another election is called, with the present cabinet staying on as a caretaker government.

item.title: Trump oferece US$1 milhão por denúncias que levem a condenações por fraude eleitoral
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que os EUA vão conceder US$1 milhão a qualquer pessoa que denunciar uma fraude eleitoral que leve à prisão e condenação, uma semana antes das eleições de meio de mandato, que, segundo as pesquisas, podem se revelar difíceis para o Partido Republicano.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que os EUA vão conceder US$1 milhão a qualquer pessoa que denunciar uma fraude eleitoral que leve à prisão e condenação, uma semana antes das eleições de meio de mandato, que, segundo as pesquisas, podem se revelar difíceis para o Partido Republicano. O governo Trump tem adotado uma abordagem cada vez mais agressiva em relação à fiscalização eleitoral, pressionando os Estados a fornecerem dados de registro eleitoral e argumentando que são necessárias medidas mais rigorosas para garantir a confiança do público no processo eleitoral. Críticos, incluindo especialistas na área política, assim como autoridades eleitorais democratas e alguns republicanos, consideram essas medidas uma intromissão excessiva do governo federal. “Qualquer pessoa que denunciar fraude eleitoral nas eleições passadas ou nas próximas eleições de meio de mandato de 2026 receberá US$1.000.000 após a prisão e condenação dos responsáveis pela fraude”, escreveu Trump no Truth Social nesta segunda-feira. Algumas autoridades eleitorais disseram à Reuters que se preparam para uma possível interferência federal nas eleições de meio de mandato. Trump já fez alegações falsas relacionadas às eleições no passado, inclusive ao se recusar a reconhecer sua derrota nas eleições de 2020. Seus apoiadores acabaram invadindo o Capitólio dos EUA em 6 de janeiro de 2021, em uma tentativa frustrada de impedir a certificação dessas eleições pelo Congresso. Atualmente, os republicanos detêm uma maioria estreita na Câmara dos Deputados e no Senado. No entanto, às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato, nas quais o controle do Congresso está em jogo, a popularidade de Trump permanece baixa devido às preocupações dos eleitores com o alto custo de vida e o aumento dos preços dos combustíveis decorrentes da guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã.

item.title: Netanyahu's political survival on the line as Israel votes
item.description: Opinion polls show a close race between Netanyahu's Likud party and its right-wing allies and a rival alliance led by Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief of staff and security hawk with backers on the right and in the centre.
item.dc:creator: Steven Scheer, Pesha Magid
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a fight for political survival in Israel's election on Tuesday, with voters weighing his leadership after the 2023 [USN:L8N4680E4 TEXT:"Hamas-led attacks"], wars in Gaza and with Iran, and Israel's deepening international isolation. Yet Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving leader with 19 years in office, remains a formidable survivor, with nationalist politics increasingly entrenched and Israel's fragmented system potentially leaving him best placed to form a government. Opinion polls show a close race between Netanyahu's Likud party and its right-wing allies and a rival alliance led by [USN:L6N46303T TEXT:"Gadi Eisenkot"], a former military chief of staff and security hawk with backers on the right and in the centre. Netanyahu is campaigning on his wartime leadership and his alliance with US President Donald Trump , who has endorsed him and joined Israel in waging war on Iran. Netanyahu said on Sunday that Trump was prepared to act again to “finally” remove the Iranian threat, but only if Netanyahu remained in power. Eisenkot has accused Netanyahu of "relying on a campaign of fear-mongering, lies and threats," and said he was confident Trump would work "in full cooperation with any leader chosen by the people." Netanyahu may again depend on far-right leaders Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich to form a government. Both have faced sanctions from some Western countries that accuse them of inciting violence against Palestinians, while [USN:L8N45T0L1 TEXT:"Ben-Gvir's Jewish Power"] party has gained support in opinion polls. Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot has a clear path to power. If neither can form a governing coalition in the 120-seat parliament, Netanyahu could stay on as caretaker until another election is held next year. Polls open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. (0500 to 2000 GMT). THE OCTOBER 7 RECKONING The election follows one of Israel's most turbulent periods since its establishment in 1948, shaped by the trauma of the October 7, 2023, Hamas attacks, Israel's subsequent military assault in Gaza and deep domestic divisions over the policies of Netanyahu's right-wing government. For many of Netanyahu's opponents, the election turns on [USN:L8N4680E4 TEXT:"accountability"] for the security failures of October 7, Israel's deadliest day. Mali Hajaj, an Education Ministry employee and Eisenkot supporter, said "the most important thing is the establishment of a national inquiry because that's where our healing will come from." Lisa Tortor said she hoped Netanyahu would go and "they can form a new government and do some of the repairing of the damage that Bibi has done for Jews all over the world and for Israel, and Israel's image." Bibi is Netanyahu's nickname. But Nof Gabay, an 18-year-old Likud supporter, rejected the idea Netanyahu was to blame for October 7 and called him "the right man for the state of Israel." "Netanyahu managed the war in the best possible way," Gabay said. THE WARTIME RECORD Israel flattened much of Gaza in the offensive launched after October 7, when Hamas-led militants killed 1,200 people and took another 251 hostage. Gaza health authorities say Israeli attacks killed 74,000 people. Israel also dealt heavy blows to Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon and traded strikes with Iran before a 12-day aerial campaign against Iranian nuclear sites in 2025 and this year's joint US-Israeli war. Eisenkot has said Israel's next government must prevent Iran from acquiring a military nuclear capability, either by force or through an "arrangement" such as a US-backed diplomatic solution. THE COALITION MATH Like nearly all Jewish-led parties in Israel, Eisenkot opposes the two-state solution that underpinned decades of peace negotiations with the Palestinians. But he has criticised Jewish settler violence against Palestinians in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, which has surged since 2023 and strained Israel's ties with Western states, and opposes Netanyahu's far-right coalition partners Ben-Gvir and Smotrich. In some [USN:L8N45Y0MD TEXT:"bastions of Likud"] support, disenchanted voters have been going door to door to turn voters against Netanyahu. Some have turned away from Netanyahu as he battles corruption charges he denies in a long-running criminal trial. A high turnout among voters from [USN:L8N45Z09Z TEXT:"Israel's Arab minority"], Israeli by citizenship but Palestinian by heritage, could help nudge Israel's complex coalition arithmetic in favour of Eisenkot. Though Eisenkot has ruled out partnering with Arab parties, citing a lack of shared values, analysts see a scenario where they prop up a minority government he leads in order to ensure Netanyahu is removed from office. "My expectation is that we will have only a slight majority either way. No landslide," said Israeli political analyst Amotz Asa-El of the Shalom Hartman Institute.

item.title: UK retail body warns 'dam is starting to break' on price rises
item.description: Britain's main retail trade body warned on Tuesday that shops are now increasingly unable to absorb the impact of rising costs, after its data showed prices increased at the fastest pace in two-and-a-half years this month.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's main retail trade body warned on Tuesday that shops are now increasingly unable to absorb the impact of rising costs, after its data showed prices increased at the fastest pace in two-and-a-half years this month. The British Retail Consortium said shop prices in October were 2.1% higher than a year ago, the biggest increase since February 2024 and up from a 1.4% annual increase in September. "The dam is starting to break on the huge wave of costs retailers have absorbed over the last two years," BRC Chief Executive Helen Dickinson said, calling on finance minister John Healey to lower retailers' property taxes and employment costs in his [USN:L5N46B044 TEXT:"first annual budget"] on Wednesday. Official [USN:L8N46708O TEXT:"consumer price inflation"], which covers a wider range of goods and services, rose to an 11-month high of 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August BRC food price inflation was 2.9% in October, its highest since April and up from 2.5% in September Ambient food price inflation rose to its highest since September 2025 at 3.2%, up from 2.2% in September Fresh food inflation was unchanged at 2.6% Non-food inflation rose to 1.7% from 0.8%, its highest since December 2023, with particularly sharp rises for furniture, flooring and home improvement goods The BRC said prices were being pushed up by higher transport and energy costs, as well as increases in employment costs and packaging levies Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said this month that businesses had so far [USN:L1N46202H TEXT:"largely absorbed higher energy costs"] caused by the US-Iran war, unlike after Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, reducing the need to raise interest rates Food price inflation has been slower to pick up than first predicted, with the Food and Drink Federation trade body now expecting it to [USN:L8N4500SL TEXT:"peak next year"] BRC data is based on prices collected from October 1-7

item.title: テニス＝世界1位シナーが12月復帰へ、延期のシックス・キングス出場
item.description: ［２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２６日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの世界ランキング１位、ヤニク・シナー（２５、イタリア）が、１２月にサウジアラビアで開催されるエキシビション大会「シックス・キングス・スラム」で復帰することが分かった。大会主催者が２６日に発表した。

シックス・キングス・スラムは当初、１０月２１─２４日に首都リヤドで開催される予定だったが、安全保障上の懸念から１２月２７─３０日に延期された。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がリヤドの国際空港を攻撃し、１３人が死亡した事件を受けた措置だった。

この延期を受け、負傷した膝の回復に専念するために今季中の復帰を断念すると表明していたシナーが同大会に参加することになった。シナーは７月のウィンブルドン選手権で優勝した後に膝の負傷を理由に戦列を離れており、過去２年連続で優勝を飾っているシーズン最終戦のＡＴＰファイナルも出場を見送ることを決めていた。

シナーは過去２回のシックス・キングス・スラム決勝でいずれもカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）を破った。今大会にはシナーとアルカラスのほか、ノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）、アレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）、テーラー・フリッツ（米国）、アレックス・デミノー（オーストラリア）が出場する。ズベレフは今季の年間世界ランキング１位が確定している。

item.title: 企業向けサービス価格9月は前年比3.7％上昇、中東情勢・秋の大型連休で
item.description:
Kentaro Sugiyama
［東京 ２７日 ロイター］ - 日銀が２７日に公表した９月の企業向けサービス価格指数...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
企業向けサービス価格9月は前年比3.7％上昇、中東情勢・秋の大型連休で 8:57 配信

写真は日銀本店。6月15日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Kentaro Sugiyama

［東京　２７日　ロイター］ - 日銀が２７日に公表した９月の企業向けサービス価格指数速報は前年比３．７％上昇と、伸び率が前月（確定値）から０．２ポイント拡大した。中東情勢の影響で輸送系業種のコストが上昇したほか、秋の大型連休の日並びが良く、関連サービスの需要が強まった。前月比では０．３％上昇だった。

前年比で指数の押し上げに最も寄与したのが「運輸・郵便」で、前年比８．４％上昇した。このうち「外航貨物輸送」が同９７．７％上昇と、過去最高の伸びとなった。中東情勢の影響で輸送コストが上昇した。「道路貨物輸送」や「道路旅客輸送」では、人件費や燃料費などのコスト増を価格に転嫁する動きがみられた。

「諸サービス」は同２．８％上昇。「労働者派遣サービス」や「建物サービス」で人件費を価格転嫁する動きがあった。「宿泊サービス」はシルバーウィークの日並びが良く、旅行需要が強かった。

「リース・レンタル」は同１１．７％上昇。リース・レンタルの対象となる機材の価格が値上がりしている。

調査対象１４６品目のうち、上昇は１１６品目、下落は１３品目だった。

生産額に占める人件費投入比率の違いで分類した指数では「高人件費率サービス」が前年比２．６％上昇と、前月から伸び率が０．１ポイント縮小した。「土木建築サービス」や「職業紹介サービス」などが押し下げに影響した。

「低人件費率サービス」は同４．８％上昇で、伸び率が０．４ポイント拡大した。「外航貨物輸送」や「宿泊サービス」などが押し上げた。

日銀の担当者は「中東情勢の影響も含めた海運市況や国際商品市況の動向、人件費・物流費などのコスト上昇の転嫁の動きの持続性などを引き続き注視していく」としている。

item.title: ドイツ銀行、ＡＩで一部企業融資の判断「数分」に短縮
item.description:
Tom Sims Hakan Ersen
[フランクフルト ２６日 ロイター] - ドイツ銀行は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の活...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドイツ銀行、ＡＩで一部企業融資の判断「数分」に短縮 8:35 配信

写真はドイツ銀行のロゴ。2024年4月、スペインのマラガで撮影。REUTERS/Jon Nazca

Tom Sims　Hakan Ersen

[フランクフルト ２６日 ロイター] - ドイツ銀行は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の活用により、一部の中小企業向け融資の判断にかかる時間を数週間から数分へと短縮している。同行の技術部門トップ、マリージャンヌ・デベルダン氏がロイターのインタビューで語った。

デベルダン氏によると、夏に稼働を開始したこの取り組みにより、多国籍企業向けの一部融資についても、判断に要する時間が数カ月から数週間に短縮された。

同氏はインタビューで「組織や法的な構造がそれほど複雑ではない比較的小規模な企業については、数週間から数分への短縮となっている」と述べた。

デベルダン氏は、同行のＡＩエージェントが顧客側のエージェントと直接やり取りする将来に向けた準備も進めていると説明した。

ＡＩ開発のペースが速すぎるのではないかというテクノロジー業界リーダーらの議論に、銀行業界も巻き込まれつつある。

デベルダン氏は「この議論を注意深く見守っている。こうした懸念には十分な根拠があり、当然ながら、サイバーリスクの管理が私の最優先課題だ」と述べた。

「こうした新技術や脅威から自行を守り続けるため、多くの経営資源と予算を投入している」と語った。

item.title: South Korea Q3 GDP beats forecasts as AI chip boom boosts exports, investments
item.description: South Korea's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter as a global AI chip boom boosted exports and investments, advance central bank estimates showed on Tuesday, though domestic demand remained weak.
item.dc:creator: Jihoon Lee
item.content:encoded: South Korea's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter as a global AI chip boom boosted exports and investments, advance central bank estimates showed on Tuesday, though domestic demand remained weak. Gross domestic product expanded 1.0% in the July-September quarter from the preceding three months, when it grew 0.6%. It was stronger than a median 0.7% increase tipped in a Reuters [USN:L6N46900E TEXT:"poll"] of economists. It was also higher than the Bank of Korea's forecast of 0.3% in August, when the central bank projected this year's growth at 3.3%. The economy is now seen growing 3.7% this year, if GDP in the fourth quarter stays at the same level as the third quarter. "It is estimated that about half of economic growth is being driven by semiconductors," Lee Dong-won, director general of the Bank of Korea's economic statistics department, told a briefing. Exports and investments are expected to remain robust in the fourth quarter, Lee said, adding that chip production volume will expand further next year while prices will continue to grow but at a slower pace. Private consumption, which fell for the first time in nearly four years in the third quarter, will likely recover gradually, as dividend payouts by chip firms to their shareholders in the fourth quarter and bonus payments to employees in the first quarter of 2027 boost household income, Lee said. Amid the global boom in AI investment, South Korea's exports topped [USN:L1N45N002 TEXT:"$800 billion"] in January to September, higher than last year's full-year record, and are on track to exceed $1 trillion this year, which will make South Korea the fourth country to reach the milestone, after the US, China and Germany. The Bank of Korea kept [USN:L4N467041 TEXT:"interest rates"] unchanged last week, after back-to-back hikes in July and September, but maintained a hawkish stance by upgrading its economic growth forecasts and remaining upbeat about the country's export momentum. "Exports and investments are leading growth, but the downside is that private consumption remains weak compared with the overall growth momentum," said Park Sang-hyun, an economist at iM Securities. "There could be short-term boosts, but it is difficult to expect strong momentum given labour market conditions and restrictive interest rates," Park said. In a separate central bank survey released on Thursday, consumer sentiment fell slightly in October, as the outlook for household income and consumer spending weakened. In the third quarter, exports rose 2.3% on demand for semiconductors, machinery and electric equipment, while imports grew 2.4%. Facilities investment jumped 4.1%, led by machinery such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Private consumption fell 0.2% as financial services declined on a stock market slump and car purchases fell due to strikes at major automakers. On a year-on-year basis, GDP grew 3.4%, after rising 3.7% in the quarter before, also stronger than economists' expectations for a 3.0% increase.

item.title: ＧＭＯ、攻撃者が顧客情報公開や追加攻撃を予告 27日正午期限
item.description: [東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＧＭＯインターネットグループは２６日夜、ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）自動売買サービスに...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭＯ、攻撃者が顧客情報公開や追加攻撃を予告　27日正午期限 8:11 配信

写真は「サイバー攻撃」の文字とPHPコードのイメージ。10月22日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＧＭＯインターネットグループは２６日夜、ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）自動売買サービスに不正アクセスしたとみられる攻撃者から、顧客情報の公開とランサムウエア（身代金要求型ウイルス）攻撃を２７日正午に行うとの予告を受けていると発表した。

ＧＭＯは一部顧客の端末を預かり、調査・解析を進めており、ランサムウエアを含むマルウエア（悪意あるソフト）が実際仕掛けられているかどうかを含め、被害状況を確認して対処方法を見いだしたい考え。

攻撃者からの要求には応じない方針を改めて示し、顧客に対し、ウイルスチェックのフルスキャンや調査への協力などの対応を求めている。

熊谷正寿代表は自身のブログで、これまでに攻撃者から５０００万ドル（約８０億円）を暗号資産で支払うよう要求があったと明らかにしていた。読売新聞などの報道によると、攻撃者は日本語のサイトで、２７日正午までに１００万ドル（約１億６０００万円）を支払うよう要求しているという。

item.title: Thunder's Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace both headed for surgery
item.description: The Oklahoma City Thunder will be down two starters for the foreseeable future as both Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are headed for surgery, general manager Sam Presti said Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Oklahoma City Thunder will be down two starters for the foreseeable future as both Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are headed for surgery, general manager Sam Presti said Monday. The Thunder revealed Williams suffered both a fractured fibula and a dislocated ankle, while Wallace has a torn labrum in his left shoulder. Their return timelines are up in the air, with the possibility that both players will miss the rest of the season. Williams suffered a gruesome injury to his left leg in the waning moments of the Thunder's 108-101 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday night. His ankle bent awkwardly as he landed after being fouled on a drive to the hoop. Presti said Williams is in great spirits. "He has an elite mindset," Presti said of Williams during a press conference. "It's what makes him a great player. It's what keeps him motivated, and it's why we all love him." Wallace was hurt in the same game after running into a moving screen. Williams was an All-Star and an All-NBA selection in 2024-25. He was limited to 33 regular-season games and five of Oklahoma City's 15 playoff games in 2025-26 due to wrist surgery recovery and multiple hamstring strains. Wallace was named to the NBA All-Defense second team last season and started all three games so far this season before his injury, a promotion for Wallace after Luguentz Dort was traded to Atlanta in the offseason. He signed a five-year, $139 million contract extension last week, while Williams was in the first season of a five-year max contract worth $239 million. "Obviously, tough night last night," Presti said. "There's no way to paint that differently. We say within our walls all of the time that there's a difference between being positive and being optimistic. I'm not going to sit up here and say this is exactly where we want to be or this is how we'd like to have it. But at the same time, we're extremely optimistic about the recovery for both of the players. Most importantly, things could've been a lot worse." --Field Level Media

item.title: ドアダッシュ、食品宅配インスタカート買収へ最終交渉 28日合意も
item.description:
Echo Wang Milana Vinn
［２６日 ロイター］ - 米料理宅配大手ドアダッシュが食料品宅配企業インス...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドアダッシュ、食品宅配インスタカート買収へ最終交渉　28日合意も 8:08 配信

写真はドアダッシュの配達員。2020年11月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Carlo Allegri

Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［２６日　ロイター］ - 米料理宅配大手ドアダッシュが食料品宅配企業インスタカートの買収に向けて最終交渉を進めていることが分かった。インスタカートを１７０億ドル程度と評価する見通しだ。事情に詳しい情報筋が２６日、ロイターに明らかにした。

早ければ２８日にも最終合意に至る可能性があるが、買収成立が確実な情勢ではないと説明している。米配車サービス大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズはインスタカートの買収交渉を進められていないという。

２３日時点で時価総額が約１３０億ドルだったインスタカートの株価は、通常取引で約８％上昇した。ドアダッシュの株価は約６％下落した。

料理宅配業界は新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック（世界的大流行）によるオンライン注文のブームが下火になった後、人件費高騰や配達員の規制強化、競争激化に直面している。ドアダッシュはインスタカートを買収する場合、顧客基盤や小売業との提携関係を獲得でき、自社の広範な配達網や顧客基盤との組み合わせが可能になる。

インスタカートはロイターへのコメントを差し控えた。ウーバーとドアダッシュはコメント要請に回答していない。

成長戦略コンサルティング会社マニフェスト・グロース・アーキテクツ共同創業者のニック・スミス氏は「戦略的に見れば、ドアダッシュの料理配達網とインスタカートの食料品分野での専門性は補完し合える強みのため、ドアダッシュの方がインスタカートにとってより自然な組み合わせだと思える」とコメントした。

これとは別にインスタカートは２６日に規制当局への提出書類で、スマートショッピングカート事業「ケイパーカート」を２７年第２・四半期末までに段階的に終了すると発表。これに伴い５５００万―８０００万ドルの税引き前費用が発生すると見込んでいる。

料理宅配業界ではドアダッシュがデリバルーの買収に踏み切り、ウーバーはポストメイツやデリバリー・ヒーローを買収すると発表していた。

item.title: Precios de la gasolina bajo el mandato de Trump superan la media de la era Biden
item.description: Trump se comprometió a bajar el precio de la gasolina a menos de US$2 por galón, pero el promedio durante su mandato ya rebasó el registrado en la administración de Biden.
item.dc:creator: Nathan Risser, Will Kubzansky, Kevin Crowley
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El precio medio que pagan los estadounidenses por la gasolina bajo el mandato del presidente Donald Trump ha superado la media registrada durante la administración Biden, lo que pone de relieve la presión política a la que se ven sometidos los republicanos de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura. Ver más: El Niño amenaza la oferta de banano y pone en riesgo sus bajos precios, alerta Chiquita Trump se había comprometido a reducir los precios de la gasolina por debajo de los 2 dólares el galón, pero, tras casi dos años de su presidencia, el precio medio al por menor del combustible ha sido de US$3,472 el galón, según la Asociación Americana del Automóvil (AAA). Esta cifra superó en menos de un céntimo la media registrada bajo el mandato del expresidente Joe Biden, que fue de US$3,471 por galón, según los datos diarios de la AAA publicados el lunes. Los precios de la gasolina se dispararon este año tras el inicio de la guerra de EE.UU. e Israel en Irán, lo que paralizó los flujos de petróleo y redujo aún más la capacidad de refinado mundial. En los últimos ocho meses, los precios medios en las gasolineras de EE.UU. han subido un 43%, mientras que los del gasóleo se han disparado casi un 70% y han superado el nivel más alto jamás registrado. La cuestión se ha convertido en un punto álgido para el Partido Republicano de Trump de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura, ya que los votantes, cansados de la inflación, se ven aún más afectados por los elevados precios de la energía. Los estadounidenses nunca habían pagado tanto por el combustible a estas alturas del año, con un precio medio nacional de US$4,286 por galón a fecha de domingo, según la AAA. Biden sigue ostentando el récord del precio más alto de la gasolina a nivel nacional, con US$5,02 por galón en junio de 2022, en los meses posteriores a la invasión rusa de Ucrania. El mercado mundial tiene un déficit de unos 400.000 barriles diarios de gasolina que, en condiciones normales, se exportarían desde Medio Oriente, según ha declarado Susan Bell, vicepresidenta sénior del sector downstream de Rystad Energy. El coste del gasóleo ha sido el principal foco de atención de la Administración Trump en las semanas previas a las elecciones de mitad de mandato, con precios que alcanzaron un máximo histórico de US$6,53 por galón el mes pasado. Los precios medios del gasóleo bajo el mandato de Trump ya han superado en aproximadamente un 6% la misma cifra registrada bajo el mandato de Biden. Los precios del combustible se han convertido en un blanco de críticas para los detractores de la Administración Trump, ya que su rápido aumento este año ha agravado la crisis del coste de la vida, que los votantes señalan como su principal preocupación. Además, representan una promesa incumplida por parte de Trump, quien criticó constantemente a Biden por los elevados precios en las gasolineras durante las elecciones presidenciales de 2024. Trump ha afirmado en repetidas ocasiones que los precios de la gasolina y el gasóleo bajarán una vez que termine la guerra con Irán, pero el conflicto no da señales de remitir. En un mitin celebrado este fin de semana, Trump se jactó de que las petroleras estadounidenses han aportado “cientos de miles de millones de dólares” al país. “‘El presidente Trump está hablando de todo el dinero que están ganando mientras la gente sufre en las gasolineras, ese será el titular’”, afirmó. “Me da igual. Lo voy a decir: estamos haciendo una fortuna de locos”. Los elevados costos energéticos amenazan con convertir zonas tradicionalmente republicanas de EE.UU. en estados indecisos. Kansas, Iowa, Ohio, Texas y Alaska, donde Trump ganó por márgenes de dos dígitos en 2024, son ahora considerados estados reñidos para las elecciones al Senado por el Cook Political Report, un organismo no partidista de análisis electoral. Los hogares de cada uno de estos estados, a excepción de Texas, dedican una parte mayor de sus ingresos a la energía que la media de EE.UU., según James West, director gerente de Melius Research LLC. Es probable que los votantes comparen los precios actuales de la gasolina con lo que Trump prometió que costaría —los precios previos a la pandemia, que se situaban de forma constante por debajo de los 3 dólares por galón—, según afirmó Ryan Cummings, jefe de gabinete del Instituto de Investigación en Política Económica de la Universidad de Stanford y antiguo economista del Consejo de Asesores Económicos de la Administración Biden, donde trabajó en materia de política de gasolina. “En realidad, lo que están comparando es una diferencia de US$1,50”, señaló Cummings. La Administración Trump ha tomado medidas para reducir el impacto de las interrupciones en el suministro de combustible derivadas de la guerra con Irán, incluidas medidas controvertidas como un acuerdo sobre gasóleo con Rusia. Pero los expertos afirman que el acuerdo es demasiado limitado para influir de manera significativa en los precios en las gasolineras de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de noviembre. La Administración también invocó el jueves poderes de tiempos de guerra para impulsar la producción de combustible en EE.UU., y el Departamento de Energía anunció el viernes que tiene US$150 millones destinados a inversiones en refinerías. Una de las mayores refinerías de EE.UU., Valero Energy Corp ( VLO ), afirmó la semana pasada que los últimos esfuerzos de Trump para frenar los precios en las gasolineras tendrían poco impacto. Los envíos de gasóleo ruso no suponen un “volumen significativo”, señaló el director de operaciones, Gary Simmons. El director ejecutivo de Valero, Lane Riggs, señaló que los planes de Trump para impulsar la producción nacional no darían frutos rápidamente. “Casi cualquier refinería que haya cerrado tardará un tiempo en ponerse en marcha, por lo que sería muy difícil que contribuyeran a resolver la situación de forma inmediata”, afirmó Riggs. “La idea de que hay refinerías en las que basta con entrar, encender la luz y ya empiezan a funcionar no se corresponde exactamente con la realidad”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: アンソロピック向けに630億ドル、米銀など ブロードコム半導体購入
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] - バンク・オブ・アメリカ、ブラックストーン、シティ、モルガン・スタンレーは、人工知能（ＡＩ）開...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック向けに630億ドル、米銀など　ブロードコム半導体購入 8:05 配信

ブロードコムのロゴ。2026年6月11日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[２６日 ロイター] - バンク・オブ・アメリカ、ブラックストーン、シティ、モルガン・スタンレーは、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発のアンソロピック向けにブロードコムのＡＩ半導体やネットワーク機器を購入するため６３０億ドルの資金を提供する。

各社が２６日発表したところによると、今回の取引は新たに設立する特別目的事業体（ＳＰＶ）を通じて行う。ＳＰＶがブロードコムのＡＩアクセラレーターやネットワーク機器を購入し、アンソロピックにリースする。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ、シティ、モルガン・スタンレーが第１順位の融資を手配し、ブラックストーンが第２順位融資のコミット分を提供する。

ブロードコムは優先債権者に「残存価値サポート」を提供し、実質的に保証を与える。資産価値が下落した場合に第１順位の債務額に相当する金額まで損失を吸収することに同意している。ただ、発表ではこの債務の規模は明らかにされていない。

各社によると、納入は２０２７年に始まる見通し。ブロードコムが関与する、既に発表済みの戦略的なコンピューティング能力に関する契約の一環となる。

アポロとブラックストーンはブロードコムとの従来の契約に基づき、アンソロピックのＡＩコンピューティング能力拡大に向けた３５０億ドルの資金供給に合意していた。

今回の取引は、ＡＩコンピューティング需要の高まりを支えるのに必要なインフラの資金調達において、銀行やオルタナティブ運用会社の役割が拡大していることを浮き彫りにしている。

アンソロピックは２６日、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開した。書類では巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになり、開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：アーム株、法外な高値を維持できそうな訳 アングル：ＡＩ関連貨物が急増、アジアの航空各社でＥＣに代わる成長要因に アングル：ＡＩ向け設備投資減速か、相場の主役はハイパースケーラーに交代も アングル：主要ハイテク企業、堅調なＡＩ半導体需要で5月に時価総額が増加 コラム：半導体ブーム、飛びつくにはなぜ遅すぎるのか 最終更新: 10/27(火) 8:05 ロイター

item.title: China's lab-grown diamond makers target AI, chip sectors for next wave of growth
item.description: Around 70% of the 2 million carats of lab-grown diamonds produced annually at Feng Canjun's factory currently go into jewellery.
item.dc:creator: Amy Lv, Casey Hall
item.content:encoded: Around 70% of the 2 million carats of lab-grown diamonds produced annually at Feng Canjun's factory currently go into jewellery. But the entrepreneur is betting that the future of China's synthetic diamond industry lies in supplying advanced materials for semiconductors, AI servers and other high-tech applications. "I am looking to raise the share of my products used in functional materials to more than 50% by 2030 while reducing the share going to the jewellery sector to a maximum of 30%," Feng said. China's lab-grown diamond producers, which account for around half of the world's supply, are looking beyond gemstones as competition intensifies and prices come under pressure. The shift could give the industry greater strategic significance in the US-China technology rivalry. If synthetic diamonds become more widely used in semiconductors and thermal management in AI infrastructure, China's production dominance could emerge as another supply-chain vulnerability for the US. "The transition is now the defining structural story in the diamond industry and one with direct implications for global technology supply chains," said Manan Goenka, engagement manager at Ken Research, a consultancy. Companies and analysts say demand from sectors including chips, thermal management and quantum technology could become the industry's next major growth engine, with synthetic diamonds prized for properties that can improve the performance of advanced electronics and computing systems. The move comes as AI drives a surge in demand for data centre capacity. The International Energy Agency said in a 2025 report that data centre electricity consumption is projected to more than double by 2030 to about 945 terawatt-hours, roughly equivalent to Japan's annual power consumption, with AI being the main driver. THE AI OPPORTUNITY Thermal management is viewed by analysts as a nearer-term opportunity, while the use of diamonds as a semiconductor material is further away from widespread commercial adoption. Chip applications also require much higher purity and tighter manufacturing standards than diamonds used in cutting and drilling tools. But interest from some of the world's biggest technology companies points to the potential for chip applications to become a new source of demand as AI computing generates increasing amounts of heat. Chinese media have reported that Huawei and TSMC (2330.TW) are exploring synthetic diamonds for chip cooling, while Lenovo (0992.HK) has launched a consumer laptop in China that it says uses a diamond-copper cooling material. In June, Intel (INTC.O) CEO Lip-Bu Tan said he personally invested in Diamond Foundry, a lab-grown diamond maker developing chip-grade diamond wafers. Huawei, Lenovo and Intel did not respond to requests for comment. TSMC declined to comment. Some Chinese producers are beginning to invest in anticipation of demand. Henan Liliang Diamond (301071.SZ) plans to redirect 1 billion yuan ($149.18 million) in funds originally raised to expand gem-grade diamond production to a new functional-diamond project, according to a June filing. In April, diamond-copper cooling modules developed by Chinese researchers improved heat transfer from chip modules by 80% and raised chip performance by 10%, according to the Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology & Engineering. Wider adoption could reshape the market for thermal-management materials that are used to stop chips from overheating. Germany's Henkel (HNKG.DE) , US chemical firm Dow (DOW.N) and Japan's Shin-Etsu Chemical (4063.T) sell products used to dissipate heat from chips. Diamond heat spreaders could compete with some existing materials if adopted widely in AI chips and data centres. Henkel, Dow and Shin-Etsu did not respond to requests for comment. Related diamond-enabled products are also being explored outside China. In June, De Beers' synthetic-diamond and advanced-materials business Element Six and Japan's Orbray said they had produced 3-inch single-crystal diamond wafers and were preparing 2-inch wafers for production in Oregon. The Spanish government [USN:L8N3X10SU TEXT:"is investing"] €753 million ($868 million) in a Diamond Foundry plant in Trujillo that will make synthetic diamond wafers. If completed, it would be Europe's first large-scale producer of diamond substrates, a material for semiconductor manufacturing. In early October, Frore Systems, a US thermal-management company, unveiled LiquidJet Diamond, a multi-stage coldplate with an integrated diamond spreader. "The scope and potential in the technology and industrial sectors could be significantly above the retail diamond jewellery business, which itself is approximately $100 billion a year," said independent diamond consultant Robert Bouquet. DIAMOND MACHINE Feng's Jiaruifu factory is one of hundreds of lab-grown producers clustered in the central province of Henan, which accounts for 80% of China's synthetic diamond output. Lab-grown diamonds are made in machines that replicate the high-temperature, high-pressure conditions under which natural diamonds form. They are physically identical to mined diamonds. One machine in Feng's factory can produce 120 carats of rough diamonds in six days, shortening a process that takes billions of years naturally. Feng has 550 such machines, each costing about 3 million yuan and weighing more than 100 tons. They have enabled him to increase annual output tenfold since launching the business in 2019, to 2 million carats in 2025, equivalent to about 9% of De Beers' production last year. Beijing has already moved to incorporate the technology into its export control regime, placing related machinery and key components under restrictions in 2024. It added more synthetic diamond products to its list in 2025, though implementation was postponed for a year under a US-China deal reached last October. "The broader implication is that synthetic diamonds could increasingly become part of the strategic trade-policy conversation surrounding semiconductors, rare earths and advanced manufacturing," said Goenka. China's rapid expansion of lab-grown diamond production has helped drive down prices, increasing pressure on producers to find higher-value applications. Gross profit margins are 30% to 40% for gem-grade diamonds compared with about 50% for industrial diamonds, according to Feng. Rather than increasing output further, he plans to shift more production towards higher-value industrial uses. While the commercial potential of synthetic diamonds in advanced industrial applications remains uncertain and risks contributing to another bout of Chinese industrial overcapacity, producers remain optimistic. "It will be a billion- or even trillion-yuan market, and we are strategically expanding into next-generation applications to replace traditional ones," Feng said. ($1 = 6.6997 Chinese yuan)

item.title: England forward Kane crowned Ballon d'Or winner, Putellas wins women's award
item.description: Kane is the first Englishman to win the prestigious award in 25 years, after Michael Owen won it in 2001.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Harry Kane completed his long quest for football's highest individual honour on Monday, with the Bayern Munich and England striker winning the Ballon d'Or after a record-breaking season that cemented his status as one of the game's greatest goalscorers. Kane is the first Englishman to win the prestigious award in 25 years, after Michael Owen won it in 2001. "Wow, wow, wow!" Kane said after taking the stage. "I am almost speechless. Being here in London has made it extra special. Made it a good omen for me tonight. Thank you to everyone who voted for me. I can imagine it was tough this year. "Some world-class players in the room tonight. Congratulations to all the winners and nominees tonight and impressive showing determination and hard work can really achieve." Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas won the Ballon d'Or Feminin for the third time. Kane's move to Bayern in 2023 brought the team trophies that had long eluded him. In 2025-26, he coupled that success with goalscoring numbers that made him the leading Ballon d'Or candidate. The England captain produced his most prolific campaign, scoring 61 goals in 51 games for Bayern across all competitions as the German side completed a domestic league and cup double. By the end of the season, Kane had established himself as Europe's leading goalscorer. His influence stretched far beyond club football. He scored six goals at the World Cup and led England to the semi-finals, combining his clinical finishing with the leadership and composure that have defined his international career. The award represents the culmination of a remarkable journey. Few players have experienced a career arc quite like Kane's, and he thanked all of his career coaches in his emotional speech, plus Tottenham Hotspur and his wife Kate. Once struggling to establish himself at Spurs as a youngster, being sent out on numerous loans, he developed into one of the most complete centre forwards of his generation, capable of scoring every type of goal while also functioning as a playmaker. "It's about the journey," Kane said. "Anything is possible, work hard when nobody is watching. "For any young boy or girl wanting to achieve their dreams, anything is possible. I wasn't the kid who went straight to the top. I had to experience the downs. I had to find my way to be the very best right now." CONSISTENCY The Ballon d'Or has often rewarded players whose success was built on flair and spectacle, but Kane's triumph is a tribute to consistency, intelligence and productivity on an exceptional scale. Week after week, he delivered. Match after match, he decided contests. There were no prolonged slumps and few quiet nights. His numbers were almost impossible to ignore. Kane finished the campaign with 73 goals for club and country, a total rarely seen in the modern era. More importantly, those goals arrived in moments of genuine significance, helping Bayern collect trophies and driving England deep into the biggest tournament in the sport. The competition for this year's award was fierce. Kylian Mbappe broke World Cup scoring records. Lamine Yamal helped Spain to World Cup glory. Yet voters ultimately chose Kane, whose excellence lasted the entire season. Mbappe finished second, followed by Lamine, Rodri and Lionel Messi. At 33, Kane has finally claimed the game's highest individual honour, adding a Ballon d'Or to a legacy that already places him among football's greatest strikers as England's all-time leading marksman and their record World Cup scorer. Putellas was presented with the women's award after winning the treble with Barcelona in the 2025-26 campaign, in addition to the Spanish Super Cup. She moved to Women's Super League side London City Lionesses in July after 14 years at Barca. Spain and Barcelona players won the young talent awards, Lamine picking up his third trophy and Vicky Lopez taking home the women's award for the second successive year. Spain coach Luis de la Fuente was named men's coach of the year, while Barcelona's Pere Romeu won the women's coaching award. The men's goalkeeper award went to Unai Simon of Spain and Athletic Bilbao, while Cata Coll of Spain and Barcelona won the women's award. Paris St Germain won the men's club of the year award, while Barcelona picked up the women's honours. Kane won the men's striker of the year prize, while Charlyn Corral was named top women's striker. Arsenal and England winger Bukayo Saka was presented with the Socrates Award for humanitarian work.

item.title: Putellas wins 2026 Ballon d'Or Feminin award
item.description: Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas was presented with the Ballon d'Or Feminin award on Monday, receiving the highest individual honour in women's football after another season of success for club and country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas was presented with the Ballon d'Or Feminin award on Monday, receiving the highest individual honour in women's football after another season of success for club and country. An international panel of journalists selects the winner, recognising the player judged to have been the standout performer over the past year. Putellas won the treble with Barcelona in the 2025-26 campaign before moving to Women's Super League side London City Lionesses in July.

item.title: Negociaciones comerciales entre EE.UU. y Canadá cobran impulso, pero siguen sin acuerdo, dice Carney
item.description: El primer ministro de Canadá insistió en que Ottawa no aceptará las condiciones arancelarias planteadas por Washington en agosto.
item.dc:creator: Nojoud Al Mallees
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El primer ministro canadiense, Mark Carney, afirmó que las negociaciones comerciales con EE.UU. han cobrado un poco de impulso y sugirió que cualquier avance se debe a que la Administración Trump ha mostrado una mayor flexibilidad. Ver más: Trump amplía exenciones arancelarias a productos de Canadá para favorecer la campaña republicana en Maine En declaraciones a los periodistas en Ottawa el lunes, Carney afirmó que “se ha producido una ligera intensificación” en las negociaciones comerciales. Estas declaraciones se produjeron tras los comentarios del presidente Donald Trump y de uno de sus asesores durante el fin de semana, en los que indicaron que ambos países se estaban acercando a algún tipo de acuerdo. Funcionarios estadounidenses y canadienses negociaron durante semanas a lo largo del verano, pero las conversaciones se rompieron el 21 de agosto, lo que llevó a Trump a imponer aranceles del 50% a productos procedentes de Canadá por un valor aproximado de US$20.000 millones. Canadá tomó represalias con aranceles de respuesta sobre productos estadounidenses de un valor similar. El primer ministro canadiense afirmó el lunes que seguiría negándose a aceptar lo que Estados Unidos ofrecía en agosto, lo que habría mantenido los aranceles estadounidenses sobre el acero, el aluminio y los automóviles, aunque a tasas más bajas. Esa ronda de negociaciones fracasó, en parte, debido a un desacuerdo sobre si Estados Unidos ampliaría la exención arancelaria a los camiones de carga media y pesada. “Tenemos límites muy claros, líneas rojas, lo que significaba que no estábamos dispuestos a firmar lo que se nos ofreció en agosto”, afirmó Carney. “En la medida en que se ha logrado algún avance, es porque EE.UU. se está acercando a nuestra posición”. El asesor económico de la Casa Blanca, Kevin Hassett, declaró el domingo a Fox News que las negociaciones comerciales con Canadá estaban cobrando impulso. “Creo que estamos muy cerca de alcanzar por fin un acuerdo al respecto”, afirmó, dos días después de que EE.UU. modificara algunos de sus aranceles sobre las importaciones procedentes de Canadá para beneficiar a las empresas de Maine, tras la presión ejercida por la senadora Susan Collins. Las conversaciones entre el secretario de Comercio, Howard Lutnick, y Dominic LeBlanc, el ministro canadiense responsable de las negociaciones con EE.UU., se han intensificado en las últimas semanas y siguen en curso, según afirmó el domingo otro funcionario estadounidense, quien añadió que las perspectivas siguen sin estar claras, ya que EE.UU. considera que Canadá aún no está ofreciendo lo suficiente. Trump también declaró el domingo al canal Fox 2 de Detroit que “nos estamos acercando a un acuerdo, y podría alcanzarse un acuerdo que va a ser muy bueno para todos”. --Con la colaboración de Josh Wingrove. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Trump administration loses push to block California votes from alleged noncitizens
item.description: A US appeals court on Monday ruled against President Donald Trump's administration in a major voting dispute ahead of the midterm elections, denying a request to block California from counting mail ballots from people on a list of more than 20,000 registered voters the federal government alleges are likely noncitizens.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen, Jan Wolfe
item.content:encoded: A US appeals court on Monday ruled against President Donald Trump's administration in a major voting dispute ahead of the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], denying a request to block California from counting mail ballots from people on a list of more than 20,000 registered voters the federal government alleges are likely noncitizens. The 2-1 decision by the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals marked the latest setback in Trump's efforts to assert a greater federal role in overseeing elections in the run-up to the November 3 midterms in which his fellow Republicans are fighting to retain control of Congress. The majority decision said the Justice Department had failed to give a lower court judge an adequate opportunity to consider the case, and therefore it would be premature for the appeals court to weigh in. The lower court judge has scheduled a hearing on Tuesday in the case. Circuit Judge Gabriel Sanchez, one of the two judges in the majority, wrote in a concurring opinion that the federal government "asks the federal court to dictate to a state legislature a matter squarely within the state's traditional domain, upending the state's policies in this regard and inviting disorder and confusion for voters and election officials alike." The lawsuit was an escalation in the Trump administration's pressure on state election officials over alleged noncitizen voting and a rare intervention by the Justice Department in the voting process weeks before an election. The California lawsuit was the first time the Trump administration sought to prevent a state from counting votes, though it did not indicate how many of the 20,000 people on its list had actually submitted a mail ballot. Justice Department officials said on October 19 that the 20,000 people included 28 who had been criminally charged with illegally voting. California is the most populous US state and a Democratic stronghold. It has more seats in the House of Representatives — 52 — than any other state. Democrats are seeking to regain control of the House from Trump's fellow Republicans in the midterms. Trump has made California a focal point of his sweeping immigration crackdown since returning to the White House, accusing it of undermining public safety through its "sanctuary state" policies that limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement. Trump has long asserted that California's immigration policies have facilitated voter fraud. All available evidence indicates that ineligible voting, including noncitizen voting, is exceedingly rare. A Reuters investigation published in July found just 129 cases in which noncitizens were federally charged with voting illegally; many appeared to stem from voter confusion or administrative errors, rather than intentional fraud. The Justice Department filed its [USN:SPN45000O TEXT:"lawsuit"] on October 15 in federal court in Los Angeles. The lawsuit asked a federal judge to order California to separate any ballots it received from people on the administration's list from the rest of the ballots, and not to count them until it had verified that the people who cast the ballots were citizens. The Justice Department filed an emergency motion with the 9th Circuit to expedite the case. California says the state's safeguards against noncitizen voting are robust, and asserted in a court filing that the Justice Department's assertions relied on "suspect data." "At best, this litigation is a reckless political stunt," lawyers for California Secretary of State Shirley Weber said in an October 20 court filing. "At worst, it threatens to disenfranchise thousands of Californians this election." Voting rights activists have expressed concern that the Trump administration's methods for scrutinizing state voter lists to identify noncitizens risk wrongly flagging naturalized US citizens for removal from the rolls. The Justice Department has told election officials in all 50 states that they could face criminal prosecution if they knowingly allowed noncitizens to remain on their rolls or [USN:L1N46212B TEXT:"cast ballots"]. It has sued 30 states and Washington, DC, for refusing to provide complete voter rolls including voters' sensitive personal data, but has lost 26 of those cases so far without winning one. "Today’s ruling is a positive development and a welcome speed bump to Trump’s disgusting attacks on the Constitution and our country’s democracy," said California Attorney General Rob Bonta, a Democrat.

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（26日）株反発 ユーロと円下落 原油6カ月ぶり高値圏
item.description: ＜為替＞ 中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まりする中、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。２５日に行われたブラジル大統...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（26日）株反発　ユーロと円下落　原油6カ月ぶり高値圏 7:12 配信

＜為替＞ 中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まりする中、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。２５日に行われたブラジル大統領選の決選投票で現職のルラ大統領が再選を果たしたことを受け、ブラジルレアルは急落した。

ユーロは先週、フランス国債の売りにより同国の債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に押し上げられたことで、下押し圧力を受けていた。ただ、この日のフランス国債価格は上昇。格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いたことで、社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ。

ただ、ソシエテ・ジェネラルの外為戦略責任者、キット・ジュークス氏は「ユーロを巡る根本的な問題は変わっておらず、スプレッドは縮小している」と指摘。「成長見通しが良好ではなく、エネルギー価格も高止まりしているため、ユーロは現時点でなお脆弱だ」と語った。

この日の北海ブレント先物は軟化したものの、依然として約６カ月ぶりの高値付近にとどまった。

市場の注目は、今週予定される主要中銀の金融政策発表に集まる。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀はいずれも金利を据え置くと見込まれている。ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）とカナダの中銀は利上げすると予想されている。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３１％高の１０２となった。前出のジュークス氏は「ドルは予想ほど堅調ではなく、いくらか逆風もあるが、米経済指標はかなり底堅い」と述べた。

円は対ドルで０．４３％安の１ドル＝１５７．４６円。

ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１７９ドル。対円では０．３１％高の１７６．０４円となった。

ブラジルレアルは対ドルで８．５％安の１ドル＝５．４レアル。ブラジル大統領選の決選投票で、左派のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り、史上初となる通算４期目の大統領職を担うことになった。ボルソナロ氏は第１回投票では首位に立ったが、決選投票では４００万票超の差で敗れた。最高裁が２５日に投票時間を２時間延長する判断を下したことを理由に、選挙結果の無効を求める意向を示した。

ゴールドマン・サックスのテレサ・アルベス氏率いるアナリストチームは投資家向けリポートで、「選挙結果を巡る争いが長引くリスクは市場心理に悪影響を及ぼすが、より根本的には、過去数週間で大幅な財政緩和が実施されたことを踏まえると、レアルなどの現地資産には一段と大きな財政プレミアムが反映されるべきだと考える」と指摘した。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　１０年債利回りがおおむね横ばいで推移した。市場では２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）のほか、週内の一連の大手ＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業の決算発表が注目されている。

今回のＦＯＭＣでは金利据え置きが決定されるとの見方が大勢。ただ、インフレ警戒感が根強い中、利上げ休止が長期間続くとも予想されていない。ＴＤ証券の米金利戦略責任者、ゲンナディー・ゴールドバーグ氏は「連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は景気を損なうことなく、段階的な利上げを続けたいと考えている。それが最大の焦点で、１２月の次回会合で追加利上げを決定すると予想している」と指摘。ただ「ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長は（今回のＦＯＭＣ後の記者会見で）今後の見通しについて多くを示唆するとは予想していない」と述べた。

ＦＲＢは９月のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりで、決定は全会一致だった。経済指標が強弱まちまちとなっていることなどを受け、今回のＦＯＭＣでの利上げ観測は後退しており、市場データによると今回の会合で金利据え置きが決定される確率は約９０％。１２月の会合で追加利上げが実施される確率は約８０％と見込まれている。

この日はＡＩ開発の米アンソロピックが米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開。これを受けＡＩ関連株が買われ、米株式市場全体も上昇した。今週は、マイクロソフト、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コムなどが相次いで四半期決算を発表。ＡＩを巡る動向が引き続き市場の焦点になると見られている。

終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは４．９８８％と前営業日比横ばい。

３０年債利回りは１．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の５．３０％。

２年債利回りは３．２ｂｐ上昇の４．７１４％。２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２７．２ｂｐ。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請がＡＩ関連株への投資家心理を押し上げた。前週まで週足で続落していたＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は、下落に歯止めをかけた。

アンソロピックは２６日、米国でのＩＰＯ申請書類を公開した。巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになり、開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

今週は２８日の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策決定、２９日の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）およびインフレ指標のほか、週を通じて多数の企業決算発表が予定されている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種構成企業の３分の１超が今週決算を発表する。ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）のアルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムも含まれ、巨額のＡＩ投資が成長につながっているかどうかが注目される。

ＲＷＡウェルス・パートナーズの最高投資責任者、ＪＰ・パワーズ氏は「きょうはアンソロピックの開示が全てで、相場は再びやや楽観的な方向に傾いていると言える。ただ、開示内容は多岐にわたる。実際に上場する際、投資家にどの程度好意的に受け止められるかが注目される」と述べた。

その上で「各材料が同じ方向を示さなければ、相場が振り回されるリスクがある。きょうは少し楽観的だが、今週の他の発表を受けて何が起きるかは分からない」との見方を示した。

ＡＩブームの最大の恩恵を受ける分野の一つとみられている半導体関連銘柄が相場上昇を後押しした。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％上昇したが、月初来では依然として１２．２％下落している。

メタは１．９％下落。ＡＩ向けデータセンターやクラウドコンピューティングの拡充などに伴う巨額の費用を賄うため、最大９５０億ドルの資本調達を実施する計画を発表した。

ＡＩ関連の取引は今月、借り入れコストの上昇を受けて債務で賄う支出の正当化が難しくなりかねないとの懸念から圧力にさらされてきた。

ただ、アンソロピックのＩＰＯ申請が投資家心理を支え、コアウィーブを含むネオクラウド企業は序盤の下げから切り返した。

その他のＡＩ関連企業も好調で、光学部品メーカーのルメンタムが約８％、コヒレントが約６％、それぞれ上昇した。

超大型株とグロース（成長）株も大半が上昇。テスラは５．２％急伸し、終値で３カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。バークレイズが投資判断を「イコールウエート」から「オーバーウエート」に引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．３６対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０９対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６７億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 原油価格が６カ月ぶり高値付近から下落し、インフレ懸念が和らいだことを背景に反発した。スポット金は０．６％高の１オンス＝４０２０．６０ドルとなり、１２月物の米金先物は０．８％高の１オンス＝４０３８．４０ドルで取引を終えた。前週末に７月２０日以来の安値を付けていたが、原油安や安値拾いの買いが支援材料となった。 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策決定会合を控え、今週は様子見ムードが強い。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 北海ブレント先物が下落して取引を終えた。中東での戦闘が和らぐとの期待が広がった。ただ、主要産油国サウジアラビアや海上輸送への攻撃が続いているため、投資家は警戒を緩めていない。価格は約６カ月ぶりの高値近くにとどまった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．９１ドル（０．８％）安の１バレル＝１１５．８１ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．５１ドル（１．４６％）安の１０１．７６ドル。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

FAST

MADRID, Oct 26 : Spain on Monday unveiled a more flexible version of its proposed decree governing data centers after a wave of project announcements in the country, according to officials at the energy ministry. • The revised proposal raises the threshold for the rules to apply, extends the time frame for developers to demonstrate renewable-energy commitments and introduces a transition period for meeting clean-power targets. • The initial proposal said that rules would apply to facilities with more than 1 megawatt of power capacity. That threshold has now been increased to more than 10 MW. • Originally, every new megawatt of energy used had to be matched by a new megawatt of renewable energy installed in the 18 months before the facility starts operation. Now, the time frame has been extended to 36 months before the start of operation, and there is no time limit for solar energy.

• The latest proposal maintains that renewable energy would have to cover at least 80 per cent of data centers' energy supply for every hour of operation. The new proposal offers an alternative: a transition period of up to five years to reach that threshold under several conditions. • With abundant renewable energy and large swaths of empty land, Spain has emerged as one of the hottest hubs in Europe, attracting projects tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure worth tens of billions of euros.

item.title: Trump, ignoring polls, predicts economy to help Republicans in midterms
item.description: US President Donald Trump campaigned on Monday in deeply Republican Mississippi, predicting victory for a Republican Senate candidate based on what he deemed to be a booming US economy, while also repeating his claim that oil prices would soon plummet.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump campaigned on Monday in deeply Republican Mississippi, predicting victory for a Republican Senate candidate based on what he deemed to be a booming US economy, while also repeating his claim that oil prices would soon plummet. Trump, a Republican, has been on a campaign blitz through normally safe Republican states ahead of the November 3 vote, with party strategists telling Reuters they are on edge about races from Alaska to South Carolina, in part because of voter discontent over how Trump's tariffs and the Iran war have fueled inflation. Sounding hoarse from his recent series of campaign rallies, Trump remarked, "God didn't make your vocal cords to do a rally every day." Trump is expected to visit Texas, Ohio, South Carolina, Florida and Iowa in the final days of the campaign, with voter concerns over affordability likely to weigh on Republicans, pollsters say. Trump acknowledged the war in Iran has pushed up oil prices, but said it was a small price to pay to stop Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon. "I thought the price of oil was going to go much, much higher," Trump said. "It's worked out fine and it'll be over soon," Trump said about the war. All 435 seats in the US House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 Senate seats are on the ballot, with public opinion polls suggesting the Democrats will regain control of the House and have a chance to retake the Senate. A Republican victory would preserve Republican control of Congress, which Trump has enjoyed since returning to the White House after the 2024 election, while a Democratic victory could impede the president and trigger congressional investigations into his administration. In Mississippi, an unexpectedly competitive US Senate race has given Democrats a rare opening ahead of next week's congressional elections. Democrats last won a Senate seat in Mississippi in 1982. Trump carried the state by nearly 23 percentage points in 2024, and he won the northeastern Mississippi county he was set to visit on Monday by 68 percentage points. But several election analysts no longer regard US Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith’s reelection as a sure bet. The Trump-endorsed Republican faces Democrat Scott Colom, a district attorney from the Columbus area, and independent Ty Pinkins, a military veteran and attorney who previously ran statewide as a Democrat. "Cindy's doing great but I've just got to make sure," Trump said. "I can't take a chance." After listing a series of economic achievements, many of them exaggerations or unverifiable claims, Trump said, "I can't help Cindy Hyde-Smith any better than that." Senate Majority PAC announced a $1.2 million ad campaign in support of Colom last week, and Democrats have dispatched big-name figures from former Vice President Kamala Harris to former presidential primary candidate Pete Buttigieg to campaign alongside the Democratic candidate. Colom came to Corinth on Monday, posting pictures of himself meeting with voters outside the venue where some 5,500 Trump supporters gathered inside. "Walking the line outside the Trump rally in Corinth, I was reminded that more unites us than divides us here in Mississippi," Colom said on X. "When I’m elected to the U.S. Senate, I’ll represent every Mississippian — whether you voted for me or not." Democrats are contesting all three Republican-held House seats in Mississippi, but none is viewed as a likely pickup opportunity. A fourth seat, represented by US Representative Bennie Thompson in a heavily Black district, is considered safe for the Democrats.

item.title: アップルのｉＰｈｏｎｅ「デュオ」に画面不具合、交換対応へ
item.description:
Stephen Nellis Aditya Soni
[サンフランシスコ ２６日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２６日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アップルのｉＰｈｏｎｅ「デュオ」に画面不具合、交換対応へ 6:24 配信

2026年10月23日、シドニーで撮影。REUTERS/Hollie Adams

Stephen Nellis　Aditya Soni

[サンフランシスコ ２６日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２６日、２３日に発売した同社初の折り畳み式スマートフォンｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」の一部で画面に不具合が生じていることを認め、対象端末を交換すると発表した。

週末には、ｉＰｈｏｎｅ　Ｄｕｏの折り畳み部分に当たる中央のヒンジに沿って、内側の画面にひびや線が生じた様子が交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿された。

アップルは２６日に不具合を認め、対象端末では問題が早期に現れる傾向があると説明した。

不具合の原因についてはコメントしなかった。

電子機器の分解調査報告や修理手順を公開するｉＦｉｘｉｔ（アイフィックスイット）は、分解映像や特許、コンピューター断層撮影（ＣＴ）の画像を使い、デュオのヒンジの３次元シミュレーションを作成し、報告された破損箇所と比較した。その結果、報告された破損は、中央の支持バー付近で画面の下を通るディスプレーケーブルのすぐ下に集中していたという。端末を折り畳む際に、このバーが画面に干渉しない位置まで下がらず、「報告された破損箇所の近くの狭い範囲に応力が集中している」可能性があると説明した。

アップルはｉＦｉｘｉｔの調査結果について、直ちにコメントしなかった。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず アングル：アップル初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ、強気価格が突きつける「誰のためのスマホか」 アングル：クック氏からターナス氏へ、アップル新体制にＡＩと「脱中国」の試練 焦点：ＡＩ時代のアップル、過去の「強み」は足かせとなるか コラム：クック氏退任のアップル、ＡＩ時代でｉＰｈｏｎｅ依存脱却なるか 最終更新: 10/27(火) 6:24 ロイター

item.title: Ex-FBI chief Comey faces third prosecution attempt by Trump Justice Department
item.description: The US Justice Department is attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey for a third time, the latest case accusing him of sharing sensitive national security information in 2016, according to court documents made public on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department is attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey for a third time, the latest case accusing him of sharing sensitive national security information in 2016, according to court documents made public on Monday. The case was revealed in a court document known as a "criminal information" that the Justice Department said it filed to stop the 10-year statute of limitations on the offense from expiring earlier this month. The document filed in Washington federal court charges Comey with transmitting and conspiring to transmit national defense information. It alleges he shared classified information with a reporter from the New York Times in October 2016. Comey said in a video on Instagram that "they're back again" and referenced the Justice Department, but did not provide further details. "I'm still innocent," he added. Comey's lawyers have already asked a judge to dismiss the case, arguing it is legally improper. “I think he’s a dirty cop,” President Donald Trump told reporters at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, when asked about Comey. “I don’t know much about it,” he said. The new case adds to the legal fights facing Comey, whom the Justice Department has already charged twice, accusing him of lying to Congress about media leaks and threatening Trump in a social media post. A judge dismissed the false statements case, while the threats case remains pending. Comey's lawyer, Patrick Fitzgerald, said in a statement that the document "purports to charge Mr. Comey with crimes that he did not commit." The criminal information was filed on October 5, but was unsealed on Monday at the request of Comey's lawyers. A Justice Department spokesperson described the maneuver to halt the statute of limitations as a "widely recognized practice in federal court." "This is an ongoing criminal investigation, and we will not comment further," the spokesperson said in a statement.

item.title: ‘Star Trek’ actor Walter Koenig passes away at 90
item.description: Veteran actor Walter Koenig, best known for portraying Pavel Andreievich Chekov in the original “Star Trek” television series and seven “Star Trek” feature films, has passed away at the age of 90.
item.content:encoded:
‘Star Trek’ actor Walter Koenig passes away at 90 Veteran actor Walter Koenig, best known for portraying Pavel Andreievich Chekov in the original “Star Trek” television series and seven “Star Trek” feature films, has passed away at the age of 90. ANI | Updated: 27-10-2026 09:35 IST | Created: 27-10-2026 09:35 IST

Late actor Walter Koenig (Image source: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Veteran actor Walter Koenig, best known for portraying Pavel Andreievich Chekov in the original “Star Trek” television series and seven “Star Trek” feature films, has passed away at the age of 90. According to The Hollywood Reporter, Koenig’s representative announced that the actor died of natural causes at his home on Sunday. Born and raised in Manhattan to Lithuanian immigrant parents, Koenig joined Gene Roddenberry’s 'Star Trek'  at the beginning of its second season. He appeared in 36 of the 50 episodes broadcast during the 1967–68 and 1968–69 seasons, portraying Russian navigator Pavel Andreievich Chekov. Koenig went on to reprise the role in the first seven “Star Trek” feature films released by Paramount between 1979 and 1991. His contributions to the franchise earned him widespread recognition among science fiction fans. In a 2013 interview for the TV Academy Foundation, Koenig revealed that he didn’t watch Star Trek before he came aboard. “I’d flip through the channels and I’d see Styrofoam rocks — they were so obviously Styrofoam — and I said, ‘This has got to be phony.’ I didn’t give it a chance,” he recalled. Before joining “Star Trek”, Koenig had appeared in several television productions. In 1963, he portrayed a student who had defected to the United States in an episode of the NBC drama “Mr. Novak”, marking the first time he played a Russian character in his career. In 1964, he guest-starred in an episode of “The Lieutenant”, another series created by Roddenberry. He portrayed a young sergeant aspiring to become an officer, whose ambitions were complicated by the fact that his mother was a communist. Koenig’s contributions to the Star Trek film franchise earned him greater recognition, including nominations from the Academy of Science Fiction, Fantasy & Horror Films for his performances in Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan (1982) and Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home (1986). On the personal front, Koenig married actress Judy Levitt in July 1965. Levitt appeared alongside him in three “Star Trek” films and also featured in “Babylon 5”. The couple remained together until her death in December 2022 at the age of 83. Their son, Andrew Koenig, was known for playing Richard “Boner” Stabone on the ABC sitcom “Growing Pains”. He died by suicide in 2010 at the age of 41.(ANI)

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-米・カナダ、鉄鋼・自動車関税の緩和協議 中間選挙前の合意も＝関係筋
item.description:
Promit Mukherjee David Shepardson
[オタワ／ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - 米...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-米・カナダ、鉄鋼・自動車関税の緩和協議　中間選挙前の合意も＝関係筋 6:01 配信

２０１６年３月撮影　REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque

Promit Mukherjee　David Shepardson

[オタワ／ワシントン　２６日　 ロイター] - 米国とカナダは、８月に貿易交渉が決裂して悪化した両国関係の修復を図る中、カナダ産の鉄鋼製品と自動車に対する米国の関税措置を緩和することで合意を目指して協議を進めている。米国側２人、カナダ側４人の関係筋が明らかにした。

焦点になっているのは米通商法２３２条に基づく関税で、カナダ産鉄鋼に対する最大５０％の関税や、自動車に対する２５％の関税などの軽減措置が協議されているという。

最新の世論調査によると、トランプ米大統領の支持率はわずか３２％にとどまり、共和党は１１月３日の中間選挙で議会の多数派を失う恐れがある。カナダからの輸入品に対する関税はトランプ氏にとって政治的な重荷となっており、国境沿いの州の共和党候補者からはカナダとの貿易戦争の終結を求める声が上がっている。

交渉内容について説明を受けたカナダ政府関係筋の一人は、鉄鋼・自動車関税を巡る合意が米国の中間選挙前に成立する可能性があると述べた。米国側関係筋によると、トランプ政権はカナダに一段の譲歩を求めている。

関係筋によると、２３２条関税は米商務省が所管しているため、交渉は米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）ではなく、ラトニック商務長官が担っている。カナダのルブラン対米貿易担当相はラトニック氏とこのところ定期的に連絡を取り合っているという。

ルブラン氏の報道官は「カナダは幅広い優先課題について米国と建設的な協議を続けている」とし、「カナダの利益を尊重し、双方にとってより有益な貿易関係の構築に向けて、建設的かつ誠実に取り組む用意がある」と述べた。

ＵＳＴＲ当局者によると、ＵＳＴＲもここ数日、カナダと合意の全体的な枠組みやその他全ての貿易問題について連絡を取り合っている。

ホワイトハウスと米商務省は現時点でコメント要請に応じていない。

カナダのカーニー首相は、米国との協議が「やや活発化した」と述べ、カナダ政府の立場は変わっていないと説明した。

記者団に「何らかの進展があったとすれば、米国がわれわれの立場に近づいているためだ」と語ったが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

カナダの業界関係筋は、合意が早期に成立する可能性があるものの、必ずしも包括的な内容にはならないと指摘。「実現するなら早いだろう。ただ、そもそも合意に至るとしても、対象を絞ったものになるとみている」と述べた。

トランプ氏は２３日、一部のカナダ産農林業製品に対する５０％関税を撤廃する大統領令に署名。中間選挙で厳しい再選戦を戦っているメイン州選出のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員（共和党）が同州の企業や農家に影響を及ぼしている関税問題への対応をホワイトハウスに求めたことを受けたもので、ホワイトハウスは合板、一部の紙製品、特定の機械や冷却設備、梱包用の木箱や容器などが関税撤廃の対象になると説明している。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ氏、関税政策を転換　法的根拠強め「強固な壁」 コラム：トランプ関税、当初の懸念より影響が限定的な理由 アングル：トランプ関税で変わる米国のメニュー、国産ワインへの切り替え進む コラム：相互関税への違憲判決とドル円・クロス円の行方＝内田稔氏 焦点：トランプ氏2期目の経済政策、現時点で結果まちまち　関税は成果出せず 最終更新: 10/27(火) 8:09 ロイター

item.title: Trump approval rises from record low to 32% ahead of midterm election, Reuters Ipsos poll finds
item.description: The president's public approval rating was 32%, up one percentage point from last week's record low, ahead of midterm elections that will decide which party controls Congress, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump 's public approval rating inched higher to 32%, up a percentage point from last week's record low, ahead of the November 3 midterm elections that will decide which party controls Congress, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday. Trump's fellow Republicans are fighting to retain the party's majorities in the House of Representatives and Senate. The five-day nationwide poll also showed that registered voters broadly favored Democrats over Republicans by 47% to 36% when asked which party they would pick for Congress in what is known as a "generic ballot" question. Some 11% said they did not know who they would vote for if the election were held today. That gap of 11 percentage points between Democrats and Republicans was 1 percentage point tighter than in a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on October 19. The latest poll additionally asked undecided voters which party they were leaning toward. Factoring in their responses, the national race appeared somewhat tighter, with Democrats leading by 9 percentage points, 50% to 41%. For Republicans, losing control of either chamber could complicate Trump's agenda in the last two years of his second term as president. Generic ballot polls are national polls that provide an overall view of which party poll respondents would like to see in charge in Congress. While these polls provide a view of national public sentiment, they do not capture the nuances of the state-by-state and district-by-district contests that determine control of the Senate and House, contests in which Republicans hold some structural advantages. STEEP SENATE CLIMB FOR DEMOCRATS Political analysts generally see the Democrats having a good chance of winning control of the House, but think they face a steeper climb to win the Senate. It remains to be seen how many voters will actually cast ballots. The voters who appeared most likely to vote still favored Democrats over Republicans by 9 points, 53% to 44%. The fight for Congress has appeared to turn on views around inflation, which has surged since Trump ordered military strikes on Iran in February that sent gasoline prices higher. Some 73% of voters in the poll said their cost of living was heading in the wrong direction. Prior to the start of the war, Reuters/Ipsos polls showed voters preferring Republicans over Democrats as the better stewards of the US economy. The latest poll showed 37% of voters said Democrats have a better approach on the economy, compared to 33% who picked Republicans on the issue. The poll also suggested Democratic voters were more excited about voting, with 46% of Democrats saying they were very enthusiastic about the midterms, compared to 30% of Republicans who said the same. The Reuters/Ipsos poll, which was conducted online, gathered responses from 1,679 US adults, including 1,280 registered voters, and had a margin of error of 2 percentage points for all adults and 3 points for registered voters.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ対ドルで下落、主要中銀会合控え ブラジルレアル急落
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２６日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まり...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ対ドルで下落、主要中銀会合控え　ブラジルレアル急落 5:44 配信

ブラジル・リオデジャネイロにある両替所で10月5日撮影。REUTERS/Pilar Olivares

［ニューヨーク　２６日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まりする中、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。２５日に行われたブラジル大統領選の決選投票で現職のルラ大統領が再選を果たしたことを受け、ブラジルレアルは急落した。

ユーロは先週、フランス国債の売りにより同国の債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に押し上げられたことで、下押し圧力を受けていた。ただ、この日のフランス国債価格は上昇。格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いたことで、社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ。

ただ、ソシエテ・ジェネラルの外為戦略責任者、キット・ジュークス氏は「ユーロを巡る根本的な問題は変わっておらず、スプレッドは縮小している」と指摘。「成長見通しが良好ではなく、エネルギー価格も高止まりしているため、ユーロは現時点でなお脆弱だ」と語った。

この日の北海ブレント先物は軟化したものの、依然として約６カ月ぶりの高値付近にとどまった。

市場の注目は、今週予定される主要中銀の金融政策発表に集まる。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀はいずれも金利を据え置くと見込まれている。ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）とカナダの中銀は利上げすると予想されている。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３１％高の１０２となった。前出のジュークス氏は「ドルは予想ほど堅調ではなく、いくらか逆風もあるが、米経済指標はかなり底堅い」と述べた。

円は対ドルで０．４３％安の１ドル＝１５７．４６円。

ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１７９ドル。対円では０．３１％高の１７６．０４円となった。

ブラジルレアルは対ドルで８．５％安の１ドル＝５．４レアル。ブラジル大統領選の決選投票で、左派のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り、史上初となる通算４期目の大統領職を担うことになった。ボルソナロ氏は第１回投票では首位に立ったが、決選投票では４００万票超の差で敗れた。最高裁が２５日に投票時間を２時間延長する判断を下したことを理由に、選挙結果の無効を求める意向を示した。

ゴールドマン・サックスのテレサ・アルベス氏率いるアナリストチームは投資家向けリポートで、「選挙結果を巡る争いが長引くリスクは市場心理に悪影響を及ぼすが、より根本的には、過去数週間で大幅な財政緩和が実施されたことを踏まえると、レアルなどの現地資産には一段と大きな財政プレミアムが反映されるべきだと考える」と指摘した。
